body:
Cringe doesn’t even begin to cover it
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260519-2827)
Peter,
Tom Tiffany had a great time at the GOP convention this past weekend.
He accepted the Republican endorsement for governor and debuted some new marketing materials aimed at reinforcing his carefully curated personal brand (pandering to voters with Wisconsin clichés).
“If there was a convention rallying cry,” right-wing blogger David Blaska observed, “it was: ‘Don’t Let Wisconsin Become Minnesota.’”
[__](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260519.piS8Tq&refcode=em20260519-2827&t=1&akid=2827%2E105371%2E5hgXv1)
“Don’t Minnesota My Wisconsin” is one of Tiffany’s longtime favorite lines (never mind the fact that he was born there).
"You Betcha!" is his newest slogan. A rhetorical cream puff!
One problem: It appears to be ripped off. From a [cannabis company](https://act.francescahong.com/go/13078?t=2&akid=2827%2E105371%2E5hgXv1). That’s based in (checks notes) Minnesota. Ope, guess that’s three problems.
_[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260519.piS8Tq&refcode=em20260519-2827&t=3&akid=2827%2E105371%2E5hgXv1)
__This is extremely funny and ironic_
The pandering is insulting; the plagiarism is just ridiculous!
Here is what Tom Tiffany is actually about:
* Voted for Trump's "One Big Beautiful Bill" — twice.
* Cast the deciding vote to continue Trump's illegal war with Iran.
* Voted to keep Trump's tariffs in place five separate times.
* Voted against extending the Affordable Care Act tax credits
* Voted to block the release of the Epstein files.
* Also, he’s against cannabis legalization.

__
_Nightmare blunt rotation._
Tom Tiffany has millions of dollars in the bank, and he can't even hire a decent marketing agency.

"You Betcha!" is his newest slogan. A rhetorical cream puff! One problem: It appears to be ripped off. From a . That’s based in (checks notes) Minnesota. Ope, guess that’s three problems. This is extremely funny and ironic The pandering is insulting; the plagiarism is just ridiculous! Here is what Tom Tiffany is actually about: Voted for Trump's "One Big Beautiful Bill" — twice. Cast the deciding vote to continue Trump's illegal war with Iran. Voted to keep Trump's tariffs in place five separate times. Voted against extending the Affordable Care Act tax credits Voted to block the release of the Epstein files. Also, he’s against cannabis legalization. Nightmare blunt rotation. Tom Tiffany has millions of dollars in the bank, and he can't even hire a decent marketing agency. Trump Calls Off Iran Strike

President Trump [revealed Monday](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2uozAQhZ_GdKDxADEuXGzjLttuiSZ4SKz1D7KdZe_bX5FHuPU5Op_O9-e-3skHn56_KbIpbV9ddmsr73hwcrlUrgf9bzlFqtXzioC3HuZe6jWFVXbOuM2R3Do2UimN46w1dC-zj6S0wn1-3KTTsLiFpFTEmogANHbeXFMwIwDIEZZhcvv8GEmpSS2jHFlMQIFLGwof70fwG6VG9e-ey8bDlmMXzKu1o4rxl0Ar0J7nOaSv5iPXKxdoL4JAC7NAK_VVySU4gTZ65wIz1SbQ-kKp_zzuG6fqcxpeLYauGHecPgRfb0pM8IzkwwfcfuDpn8HvAAAA__-VlHca) he had postponed a "very major attack" on Iran after Tehran submitted a peace proposal through Pakistan. Gulf state allies -- Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and the UAE -- asked for a two-to-three-day pause to allow negotiations to proceed. Trump said [there's a "very good chance"](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGurCAYhJ9GOwwCihYUt7Hb297S_PL_umQRDOD17NufuMV5gNNNZpLJfPPvMT_AeRe2v7CTSWWdMeJc0rkfFDCmTPmArxLDDjk7mgUXPeMda8c5-Lmt0aBFaG1NptV6FLIbR14_jRyXRfZAyK3uFIFVqAYObd8No1q7tXbmruKd4Jy3kg-NwrVbJGit9CBbSZXi4CmVJtFxLt5ZCAXya43JUmPjXnvzLOXIlfxTiakS03VdTaKzUMp3fjsxeazEhDGAR_ahYhnemW0xIrNPCJaYSxBYOK0nSAwJPIO10C09vF3YWC7JvYj9oA-VmOpk8Lic9y73ulJ828H5z6zyixf_G_EdAAD__70Fgxg) of a deal limiting Iran's nuclear program. The U.S. military remains at "moment's notice" readiness. Pakistan is serving as the intermediary between Washington and Tehran. The diplomatic opening complicates months of escalation. Trump has repeatedly threatened new strikes since the U.S. war with Iran began in late February. A deal -- if it materializes -- would represent a dramatic reversal, giving the president a foreign policy win [heading into the midterms](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLtuwyAYhZ8Gb1hcbBMPDF28pWtH6zf8TlC5WIBD2qevkkfoeHSkc_R9X9f1Cs67ePuEgDrXfbXJrjWf4cBoUy5YDnjWFAOU4nAVTEyUjZTPa_Qr76y2xgI3HWqu1CzkOM-su2sjN2N2IQGUGSclBwQ1GURAlLOFrXP6NcVGwRjjkl36we7jJkGpQV0kl0gGBh5z7TMe5-adgVihfO8pG-xNCp3X91qPQuQHEQsRS2ut39MzYiuvnojFuwfSVyZieSNRlyHSBpm6kgE9vacczl8aT-MRMrUIngb4ofzSZW2P5rx3ZVJkYLcAzr9_6z80PbT4CwAA___OiHp7). ★★★

Blanche said payments to convicted January 6 defendants are "possible." Senate appropriators pressed Blanche on who qualifies and how decisions will be made. [The fund's structure](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2O6yAUhJ_G7hwd_gwUFLdJl9tuaR3gOEHBNgKy2cdfOY-w5WikGX3f1225Ycppv__HjVzt6xKPuPT62grt8aiNWsGffuwbtpZo4cDnCdTE7LLnhY3RxRCRhZEc09pyoayF8eFkMIp5ICa1WiWiFZwZv6p5tsZa6cfkzilQHACYAHORcVVeoNZSG8EEDRIwU-2XSuXlcwq4d2zP9aiBLuHYxuwevZc2iH8Dvw78imWndzurM9SeQqaBXz8sU8Z3e6U-pdqmTPichOY2kjBag1fKeAKmGUcmhRTar2asLpZ3yjm1WQ8S7hum_Pntf9D07fhvAAAA__-AhnTn) gives DOJ broad discretion to decide who receives compensation. ★★★

I’ve spent my career fighting against corruption. But what we’re seeing right now is unlike anything I’ve ever seen before. Let me just catch you up on what just happened. Donald Trump decided to sue the IRS — his own government that he runs — for $10 billion over the leaking of his tax returns during his first administration. But just after a federal judge had ordered both sides to explain why the case didn’t create a massive conflict of interest — because Trump controls both the agency he sued and the lawyers defending it — this took a different turn. His personal lawyers and his DOJ lawyers (remember they’re supposed to be on two different sides in this case) reached a sham settlement where the government agreed to create a $1.8 billion fund to compensate his political allies who believe they’ve been “wrongfully convicted,” potentially including the people who attacked the Capitol on January 6th. All paid for by American taxpayers. This level of corruption is staggering. And it's why I introduced the Ban Presidential Plunder of Taxpayer Funds Act — legislation to make it illegal for a sitting president or vice president to receive settlement payments from the federal government they control — or to direct those payments to a third party. [**Add your name if you want to help put an end to this corruption, stop politicians from rigging the system, and make sure taxpayer dollars are never treated like a personal slush fund again.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-trumpIRS/?source=EW_EMZ31I_COR_ENG_20260519_F&t=8&akid=2906%2E4032634%2EYIyUsV) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-trumpIRS/?source=EW_EMZ31I_COR_ENG_20260519_F&t=9&akid=2906%2E4032634%2EYIyUsV)
---
Look, Trump used the threat of a lawsuit against his own government to pressure nearly $2 billion out of the U.S. Treasury.
No jury decided this. No judge approved it. Congress never voted on it.
It’s like Trump said: _Nice lawsuit I’ve got here. Shame if someone had to keep defending against it... unless there was a payout for my allies._
And what makes this especially outrageous is how the fund was structured. Once the money is transferred, the government’s own order says it has “no liability whatsoever” for what happens next.
No accountability. No oversight. No clawback. Just $1.8 billion flowing into a fund controlled by Trump’s DOJ, to be distributed however they choose to Trump’s allies.
My legislation would ban presidents and vice presidents from collecting settlement payments from the government they control, require transparency and independent oversight, and impose real penalties for abuse.
This legislation draws a hard ethical line: Presidents cannot try to financially benefit from the very government they are controlling.
[**Add your name if you believe no president should be able to turn a sham lawsuit into a billion-dollar cash grab for political allies.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-trumpIRS/?source=EW_EMZ31I_COR_ENG_20260519_F&t=10&akid=2906%2E4032634%2EYIyUsV)
Thanks for being part of this,
Elizabeth

Donald Trump decided to sue the IRS — his own government that he runs — for $10 billion over the leaking of his tax returns during his first administration. But just after a federal judge had ordered both sides to explain why the case didn’t create a massive conflict of interest — because Trump controls both the agency he sued and the lawyers defending it — this took a different turn. His personal lawyers and his DOJ lawyers (remember they’re supposed to be on two different sides in this case) reached a sham settlement where the government agreed to create a $1.8 billion fund to compensate his political allies who believe they’ve been “wrongfully convicted,” potentially including the people who attacked the Capitol on January 6th. All paid for by American taxpayers. This level of corruption is staggering. And it's why I introduced the Ban Presidential Plunder of Taxpayer Funds Act — legislation to make it illegal for a sitting president or vice president to receive settlement payments from the federal government they control — or to direct those payments to a third party. | Look, Trump used the threat of a lawsuit against his own government to pressure nearly $2 billion out of the U.S. Treasury. No jury decided this. No judge approved it. Congress never voted on it. It’s like Trump said: Nice lawsuit I’ve got here. Shame if someone had to keep defending against it... unless there was a payout for my allies. And what makes this especially outrageous is how the fund was structured. Once the money is transferred, the government’s own order says it has “no liability whatsoever” for what happens next. No accountability. No oversight. No clawback. Just $1.8 billion flowing into a fund controlled by Trump’s DOJ, to be distributed however they choose to Trump’s allies. My legislation would ban presidents and vice presidents from collecting settlement payments from the government they control, require transparency and independent oversight, and impose real penalties for abuse. This legislation draws a hard ethical line: Presidents cannot try to financially benefit from the very government they are controlling. body:
cadem.org [cadem.org]
California Democratic Party Releases Final Edition of California VOTER Index
Today, CADEM released the fifth and final edition of the California VOTER Index [https://cadem.org/california-voter-index/] . The 1,200-sample survey of likely June 2026 voters was conducted May 14-16 online and via phone by EVITARUS [https://evitarus.com/] – the only Black- and Latina-led full service public opinion research firm in California.
The surveys included each candidate’s official ballot designation and party affiliation. In addition, oversamples were completed for Latino, Black and Asian-American voters to avoid small sample sizes and ensure clarity in data results.
Today’s results show voters are highly engaged with 37% saying they have already voted, and of those who have not yet voted, nearly all have a plan to do so.
The survey also shows Republican Steve Hilton garners 22% support (and continues to outpace Chad Bianco's 10% support), and Democrat Xavier Becerra holds 21% of the vote and continues to consolidate support of both Democrats and Independents.
Becerra also currently maintains the broadest coalition of any candidate for Governor with 35% of Democrats—a 6-point increase from May 4th—and 19% of Independents.
Today’s topline survey results show:
* Steve Hilton (R) - 22%
* Xavier Becerra (D) - 21%
* Tom Steyer (D) - 15%
* Chad Bianco (R) - 10%
* Katie Porter (D) - 7%
* Matt Mahan (D) - 4%
* Antonio Villaraigosa (D) - 1%
* Tony Thurmond (D) - 1%
* Betty Yee (D) - <1%
* Eric Swalwell (D) - <1%
You can view today’s topline poll results and crosstabs by clicking here. [https://cadem.org/california-voter-index/]
“My message to California Democrats is simple,” said CADEM Chair Rusty Hicks . “Cast your ballot today and ensure your vote is counted in this important election.”
The California VOTER Index follows an open letter [https://cadem.org/open-letter-to-the-democratic-candidates-for-governor/] sent by Chair Rusty Hicks to Democratic candidates for Governor, including those who subsequently filed for the Primary Election ballot. CADEM launched the California VOTER Index [https://cadem.org/cadem-chair-rusty-hicks-launches-california-voter-index-to-track-governors-race/] to help all candidates honestly assess their viable path to win.

subject: Please help me prove them wrong
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail
body:
They think that if they throw enough at us, our movement will lose steam before November.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2220%2E791427%2EloNL6O)
Friend,
The GOP is making a bet right now.
They think that if they throw enough at us – enough smears, enough distractions, enough outside money – our grassroots movement will lose momentum before November. They think supporters like you will tune out.
I need your help to prove them wrong. Not with hours of your time. Just this:
So please: [**Add your name to personally endorse my campaign for Congress >>**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-may26-personal-endorse/?source=em260519-1-b&refcode2=2220.791427.loNL6O&akid=2220%2E791427%2EloNL6O)
**[ADD MY NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-may26-personal-endorse/?source=em260519-1-b&refcode2=2220.791427.loNL6O&akid=2220%2E791427%2EloNL6O)**
Because here’s what’s actually happening in the real world while they try to undermine us:
Groceries _cost more._ Gas _costs more._ Rent _costs more._
Trump blew up decades of trade relationships overnight, despite economists warning that it would hit working families the hardest. He’s dragged us into a war with Iran that has made prices at the pump skyrocket – with no plan in place and no vote from Congress.
And through all of it, Trump’s only consistent priority has been to hand his billionaire family and their billionaire friends massive tax cuts.
Working families across the country are facing the consequences of every reckless decision this administration makes.
Families across the country see it. They’re living with it. And they need someone in Congress who will fight back every single day without backing down.
By adding your name right now, you make it clear that we see exactly what’s happening, and we are not backing down.
So: [**will you please take a minute and personally endorse my reelection campaign? This small and simple action goes a long way in showing the GOP just how strong our movement is.** **[ADD MY NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-may26-personal-endorse/?source=em260519-1-b&refcode2=2220.791427.loNL6O&akid=2220%2E791427%2EloNL6O)** In solidarity, Ilhan

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: The Dems are at war. Rubio just opened a 16-point lead.
body:
Plus: $165 billion Project Jupiter is coming. Here's the catch | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/FAv8YZ3CcoO?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | |
Marco Rubio just opened a 16-point lead over JD Vance for 2028.
Meanwhile a former Democratic governor went on national TV and torched her own party. A former Albuquerque mayor went after a fellow Democrat in the Journal. AOC is leading the Democratic primary at 26%. One party is finding its next leader. The other is still fighting over its last one.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/NgwfvnyRVSY?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
🚨 **DEMOCRATS ARE AT WAR WITH THEMSELVES**
Christine Gregoire — former Washington governor — went on national TV and torched her own party. The four-word phrase she used about Democratic spending should end up in every GOP ad this cycle.
Then former Albuquerque Mayor Marty Chavez wrote an op-ed going after Sam Bregman in the Journal. Democrat-on-Democrat, in print.
And the 2028 Democratic field? AOC 26. Buttigieg 22. Newsom 21. Harris 12.
**Their frontrunner has never run anything.

** 🔥 **RUBIO 45, VANCE 29 — A 22-POINT SWING IN FIVE MONTHS**
Five months ago, JD Vance led Marco Rubio by 24 points. Now Rubio leads by 16.
Vance has been quiet. Rubio has been everywhere. Then Trump went to the Rose Garden and floated a Vance-Rubio "dream team" ticket.
The crowd's reaction tells you everything.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://us.list-manage.com/vRKwgaEMShD?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
💰 **$165 BILLION IS COMING TO DOÑA ANA COUNTY**
Project Jupiter. Oracle. OpenAI. A 1,400-acre AI data center campus in Santa Teresa.
Seven in 10 Americans say they oppose AI data centers near where they live. A separate project near Fort Bliss would need more power than every El Paso Electric customer combined.
That's the number that should stop you cold.
Florida's Ron DeSantis is doing this differently. Mark walks through what Santa Fe should be studying — before the next one lands here.

🇨🇳 **A CHINESE SPY WAS ELECTED MAYOR. NBC IS WORRIED ABOUT SOMETHING ELSE.**
Eileen Wang, mayor of Arcadia, California, just pleaded guilty to acting as an illegal agent of the Chinese government.
NBC's tweet didn't lead with the espionage. It led with "anti-Asian discrimination" concerns. We walk through, line by line, how a major network frames a story like this.

🎬 **TMZ TRIED TO BURY SPENCER PRATT. HE DIDN'T BLINK.**
Harvey Levin spent ten minutes trying to get the LA mayoral candidate to admit the Airstream on his burned-out Pacific Palisades lot isn't really his house. Pratt's response is the part we want you to see.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://us.list-manage.com/qujmisUZwh4?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
PLUS: Three NM Republican write-ins (Larry Marker, Joshua Lawrence, James Ellison) each need 2,351 votes to make the November ballot. Jim Jordan on CNN with Kaitlan Collins — it does not go well. A septic truck loses a fight with a train in Virginia. And a bear manhandles Mark's trail camera.

body:
This is reckless.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3288%2E21716%2Eg3xWjB)
Right now, the Trump administration is pushing a proposal that would allow **handguns to be shipped through the U.S. Postal Service** for the first time since 1927.
[](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/sign/em-20260519-2-usps-proposal/?source=em20260519-3288&t=2&akid=3288%2E21716%2Eg3xWjB)
[**Will you add your name to our petition and join Sarah McBride in opposing this dangerous plan to allow handguns to be sent through the Postal Service?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/sign/em-20260519-2-usps-proposal/?source=em20260519-3288&t=3&akid=3288%2E21716%2Eg3xWjB)
**[Add Your Name »](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/sign/em-20260519-2-usps-proposal/?source=em20260519-3288&t=4&akid=3288%2E21716%2Eg3xWjB)**
At a moment when gun violence continues to devastate families and communities in Delaware and across the country, Donald Trump wants to make it easier to mail handguns across state lines. **That’s absolutely reckless.**
This proposal could weaken background check systems, make firearms harder to track, and loosen oversight of the firearm industry — all to hand the gun lobby another win.
**And here’s the thing: the Trump administration is betting that we’re not paying attention.** They're counting on people being too exhausted by the daily chaos to notice this dangerous move, and that no one will speak up until it’s too late.
But Delawareans sent Sarah to Congress to fight for gun safety — not stand by while extreme politicians make it easier for weapons to move across the country.
That’s why Sarah is opposing this rollback of federal safety protections and urging Congress to do more to protect our families, our kids, and our communities from gun violence.
[**We need your voice to help us show strong public opposition to this proposal. Will you add your name to join our fight?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/sign/em-20260519-2-usps-proposal/?source=em20260519-3288&t=5&akid=3288%2E21716%2Eg3xWjB)

Team McBride

Dear friends,
California Democrats are organized, energized, and ready to win on June 2nd.
Across the state, organizers are knocking doors, volunteers are making calls, and local teams are mobilizing voters in the districts that will decide the future of the House Majority.
And the momentum is real. We’re seeing incredible energy in key battleground districts:
➡️ CA-48
➡️ CA-22
➡️ CA-13
➡️ CA-47
➡️ CA-45
➡️ CA-27These are some of the most competitive races anywhere in the country. And right now, California Democrats are doing the work needed to win them.
Our organizers are on the ground every single day:
✔️ Recruiting and training volunteers;
✔️ Talking directly to voters at the doors and on the phones;
✔️ Building turnout operations before ballots are cast;
✔️ Expanding our outreach in communities that will decide this election.
Republicans are already flooding these districts with attacks, misinformation, and outside money because they know what we do in California will determine control of Congress.
But we know something they don’t: Grassroots organizing can overcome dark money.
We’ve spent months preparing for this primary. We have been on the ground since January. We didn’t wait until the last minute. We built the infrastructure, expanded our volunteer programs, and invested in year-round organizing through our Forever Organizing initiative, not only to be prepared, but to build lasting power and impact in communities across the state that will continue long after Election Day.
Now, with the June 2 Primary Election approaching fast, we’re seeing Democrats across California stepping up with incredible energy and determination.
The path to taking back the House runs straight through California. And the strength of our organizing right now should give every Democrat hope.
If you want to help us keep this momentum going through Election Day, there are TWO ways you can help today:
1) You can sign up to volunteer [https://linktr.ee/cadem] and help reach swing voters and get out the vote for Democrats up and down the state;
2) You can chip in below to support our organizing efforts in battleground districts across the state. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cdp-may26?&refcode=&amount=]
CHIP IN $ >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cdp-may26?&refcode=&amount=]We’re almost at the finish line. Join us for our final push these last two weeks and let’s win this, together!
- The entire team at CADEM HQ

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

BREAKING news, Peter:

Justice Democrat Chris Rabb just won the Democratic primary for
Pennsylvania’s 3rd congressional district by over 10 points in a
landslide!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260519-2.wlvP5l&refcode=em20260519-37796&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=37796%2E1203867%2EIUgYsw ]Congratulations PA-03 Primary 2026 WINNER Justice Democrat Chris Rabb

This is a massive upset for the Democratic machine in Pennsylvania, and a
huge win for our progressive movement nationwide. Instead of electing an
establishment pick, the people of Philadelphia chose to send a bold,
progressive leader to represent the bluest district in the country. It’s
about time!

Chris will now join Rep. Summer Lee as the second Justice Democrat from PA
in Congress, and we couldn’t be more proud.

Despite being up against over $3 million in spending primarily from 314
Action Fund — a PAC previously used by AIPAC as a pass-through — Chris and
his people-powered team out-organized his opposition to build the broadest
coalition of local leaders, grassroots organizations, and national
progressives to win this race.

From the very beginning, Chris ran an uncompromising campaign to end
pay-to-play politics and build a government that answers to its voters,
not billionaires and corporate lobbyists.

And unlike his opponents, he never shied away from calling what Israel is
doing in Gaza a genocide, and proudly rejected contributions from AIPAC
and corporate PACs.

Chris is exactly what Democratic voters nationwide are demanding —
progressive trailblazers who fight for their communities, not just when
it's politically convenient but when it's morally necessary.

While the party machine has spent decades failing to meet the needs of its
voters, Chris has taken the fight to corporate interests, billionaire
CEOs, and Republican extremists his whole career.

Anchored by grassroots organizing on the ground from Pittsburgh to Philly,
together alongside Summer Lee and Chris Rabb, we are ensuring a new,
powerful progressive movement leads Pennsylvania towards the future it
deserves.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260519-2.wlvP5l&refcode=em20260519-37796&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=37796%2E1203867%2EIUgYsw ]As we celebrate this momentous victory, help us deliver more losses to

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260519-2.wlvP5l&refcode=em20260519-37796&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1022&akid=37796%2E1203867%2EIUgYsw ]Contribute $5

Thanks again for everything you did to rally around Chris and expand our

and New Jersey, two weeks from today!

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas

## Trump Halts Iran Strike at Last Minute
President Trump said he was "[an hour away](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O6yAQRp8Gd0R4_F9Q3IYut93SwjCOZ4PBgkmsvP3K-wpbf9Knc87Xfb5bChQf_-2Omtc0RzxLQGbMM2UbT5ttZlrJkQ1uI_fEiDMo6KXqJKjZWwqfua28XhEBmwp1PQwTDHXfNtWmR-V7hWC7pfXTOtnV9apZxhb9UrfLCBXp6011oGqlBlA3O9Vd76axHsbBgxtEq9ATp3z7ThR5wzV80hvzzaW9CnpjPopo_gkwAkz8HKnwNQkw17EAozoBpp4EmFeRl58Aw_m1HzLjG20ockundCEVlBvK0xbJSWYsfKnHhyyc6YlFpiivJgJMlbU_TgqBSn8BPnZL4ReI_1TxreEnAAD__zGfhe0)" from striking Iran before calling off the attack Monday at the Gulf allies' request. Vice President JD Vance said the administration is "[locked and loaded](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkT-P3CAQxT8N7ljhwX8LFyslK6W4VFFSWhMY1nPGYGFufdvks0f2NulTvR_z0KD3-PU2viF7DvfvuNCQXRwD7ZunnCmNnDDsmDBldmwYvZnYzBRoBAWNVLUENVpk_xyrwg6OCEgXNJRt20NbNpUupqGyCJW21ipCp6BpfytX6tZUWnVgqC94OLapGlSpVAvqgn1ZN6bvyrZrLZhWVIos55gu75FDnsj5Z3xQupi4FH6Ycl43oa8CbgJu-75fXPw8Uhy-gJvnB8njLOCW08eyygl93uSC7zFJzBnNLGOQR1q55cQzyfBhPGGSO-EawybXFO8JF7ngU5a9AC309Y_Q10yfWegvPzEYElCD2vC5nfDjeOkkfg0E1F9BQN0d1Hc-mpns6WB4qY9oz9E_9_rTieGUbwlfwO6UjH5-LXfIvkiDXXf2nrfm6Oy-IPuzo_xfH_sY4G8AAAD__0cGsBw)" to resume strikes if talks collapse, and Trump gave Tehran two or three days to make a deal. U.S. forces have [turned away 88 ships](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLuOszAQRp8GOiMzXF24-Bu6_O2WaBiGMBtzke3EytuviPYNth7N0Tnf1228oTjZ7_9xYxuXY9w5Bccxsh_F457Qo4-yCAk6WoUevPMIGlqlGwV6nFHce6zz2S7MwFXOtuw6A13Z1lW-2rIGg41GNGWlm3Zp-mUxdU-m6pFgolzsRdMN6FLrDnSBpmxaMn3Z9d0M1GW15lni4YvvQ_a48uLex4t9QceWO7vGeIas-pfBkMGQUipoClfFdc9gcPJi9TxnjBwyGK4oldCr6J_bqU5GYjUzOoUxIj3UeYQgk-MPrzqPEH-_VT0Zaqmn3Nv5TOKchPayu28o7mMT_zThy8JPAAAA__9guoXx) under a naval blockade of Iranian ports, the head of U.S. Central Command told House lawmakers. Iranian state TV ramped up propaganda, with one anchor [firing an AK-47](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOszAQBOCngS5ovQYbFy7-hi5_eyXa4HXYOwdHjgWXtz9xr3D1SN9o5uM6X0mSbPf_9GBfY543Pl6Ja-UyS6HtoEKlSpRFKC2rLF-88YyA5gLDBWEOJOk9923wkRlZt-yVtQ6tMr1uV08WWJtAowkq3MYbWOMoattHFXqOsRV_ajAgKACL0JFTg1ncqOxoAy626YGD1Fy6zyxbXTmmd965dEt-tMmvtT5fjf7X4NTgdBxHF_P3ueLMG5x2CZwbnIx2g3M9glYK2-LD85CU5GXOgvuDJP2C9U8v7B5_AgAA___E-W7c) in the studio after weapons training from a Revolutionary Guard member.
## Mosque Guard Hailed for Saving Lives
Amin Abdullah, the security guard killed Monday at the Islamic Center of San Diego, was a father of eight who [stepped between two teenage gunmen](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3OnDAURJ8GOiP_gZfCRRq6L21KdGNfw80ae2ObRfv2EVHeIN2RRhqdmR9f6xdQpLR9hwNtC3lNeNWIrWFZqUC6oEBpFMgRRLeTe2LCVXI5MT4yyVcPFD-r7r0NiBJVj1YYM0sjJq363XLlYdZ8MpMOszbjKIJSs-YigDIuiJ7s3cZHyQXnRvIBZjFObn4I8zBeOtNpjp5aLsOvTKntGOInv7EMLh99tHtrr9qpb51cOrlc1zWkn-5eceedXG7s5HJW9o92LJkcq-jOQu3DthOKZ0-KET17ldzQNUobcztFXzCx2iAEViExT7hlduT6-2TFJVB6fCjRF-tfF8VIdbpttwMo_rVr_3Xp28o_AQAA___O1owR) and more than a dozen children inside. _"It's fair to say his actions were heroic. Undoubtedly, he saved lives today,"_ [said San Diego Police Chief](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFu9CAUBODT4A4LnrGxC4q_cbd_m9Ji4bF-CYYVRkv29pFzhdQjzXyaj9t2sxQpPf7bA00NeUvYzoi1Ytmo2NRssaVSIEc2up3cFybcQMDExchBbN5SfG-q8yYgAg4dGqn1AlpOauh2I1GHUXg_zZMYFhW8d7MM90Vq5e5a647M1SZGEFIIDaK3ixwnt8xSz9qD00wJ9FRz6T8zpbpjiO_8wtK7fHTR7LU-Tzb8Y7AyWFtrffsmknDFDNZL7yIyWE-buCd8ZG5dpRfyc8-5YuF0RnuQ4w5TxcJg1XJQUqixK8Y_G8VI53QxHoel-Dtb__TVy8BPAAAA__9mcHzd) Scott Wahl. A family fundraising effort has [topped $2 million](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO8yAQhJ_G7mLhJRi7oPgbd_nbK9EGFnsvxEQEBfntT9wrXDfSSN_om6-bvSFHPrb_-CRTQrIH1XekUihbznhUzJgLB3aM0e3sHnSQBQHTRagLCOuR42mvvTeBCEj2ZEatF9DjdJX9bmYtFQYVFBFJMU5aS5y1kyKgXLxSPZtGEwrEKIQGMeAyqskt86hn7cHp7irIc0l5-E58lJ1CPNOH8uDSs49mL-X17uS_DtYO1lrrcL-71nWwNpkO1mbgIrXo4vmS2yPXbUl9Nv5VOUZ-T21leyLHX2r50xUfAz8BAAD__xEiceg), and worshippers described him as a mosque fixture for over a decade who greeted every visitor with a smile, including the homeless and elderly. The other victims, Mansour Kaziha and Nader Awad, also died confronting the gunmen. The teenage attackers, [Cain Clark and Caleb Velasquez](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGy2yAQRb8GdXhgZQm5oEhD99Km1KxgJW2MwAFsj_P1GeUXXn1nzpxzf33NX8iR0_YTD7JtzXOid43UGpWZC6Y3FiyNV_aM0e_s75RoBgWjVIMENQfk-JmvXbArEVDfkdXG3MDo8dp3uzV6CuNCy6qXtafJTAauevK9Vh6XAGPH9qSpAZRWyoC64E0Po79N2kwmgDfiqihwy-XyO3NqO63xk19ULj4fXbR7a48q-h8CnACXPo9c2zkJcCdYgFODAKcnAe5Z5dknwFVMMjBtWR65_nmSrHvOjdMmMUbaKMjtmQ5KkgOls5-CxCo9cpI-YrlLTEF6jLTIF0U8GX8FuK7Y8HhzjFzH03w7kON_0_ate18W_gUAAP__qbKPAg), killed themselves nearby; investigators found anti-Islamic writings and Nazi imagery.
## What's America's Favorite Pizza Chain?
A [new YouGov survey](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOozAQBOCngc7IbADHhYtr6HLtlWhjr8NejB3ZPrjk6X_xv8JfjzT6Zv7clhty4Pj4jRuZ6tMS6SiBaqW8cMZ4YMZc2bNlDHZl-6RIC0iYhBwFyMUhh_cytM54IqBLS6ZXSoPqp-HSrgat7uXdapwI3RXsqLV18q784L3uJ9-yOdvkCLKXUoHsUPfjZPW1V1flwKpmkOS4ptz9TRzrSj680065s2lrg1lrfZXm8quBuYH5OI7Op__nijNvYPYpOeEyx2cDM26U2WIRdypVVCyV40O8-PNBYVfkKFJwotg1pSA87ilzJVH-5Z3ewnN0pc3GvQ4Ogct00h4bcvim1B_9txv4CgAA___CCYfc) ranking America's favorite pizza chains named Pizza Hut as the No. 1 chain, edging out Domino's among 44,000 diners. Pizza Hut won 19.1% of the vote to Domino's 17.1%. Papa John's came in third at 11.4%, Little Caesars fourth at 5.3%, and Marco's Pizza [rounded out the top five](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2S4yAQhJ9GylAN6AcpILjEmS-9UDUHgzW7CFQIm7Kffst-hc27uvv7_l3XK3LgePuLO5ni0xqpnoFKobxyxlgxYy7s2TIGu7H9pkirAjUJGIWC1SGH5zq0zngiRX1LRmq9KC2noW83o3u79OhGkDDOWv53Q2_dLJGAPOHgWzbvNhgVSACtoMNFjpNdZqln7ZTVzQDkuKTcfSWOZSMfnulBubNpb4PZSjnOpv_TqEujLrXWzqfkMLrKkd6ZRl32dBZxpOMeMIuDXy8UdkOOp-AocKfMFsUz3W_pITIdKRfxQZRy0ROAbrNxR-UQ-Jzef247cvjsl19Jexj1EwAA__-x3oEa) with 4.7%, based on responses collected from March 2025 through February 2026. Researchers attributed Pizza Hut's lead to a [nostalgia factor](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu3CAQRb8Gd6xg1ga7oEhD99KmtCZ4eJ4EYwt4Xnm_PnLyCanv1dHR-fExfyAnzp_fcSPX4j5netVErVGZuWB-YcHSOHJgTGHl8JsyzaDASDVIUPOCnK657xYXiYCeHTlt7QRWm_7ZrW4y2kREFcNoIo2gB2P6YewX24-kf6qO3U1TAyitlAX1wEkPJkyjtqNdIFjRK1q47eXxa-fcVorp2k8qj7BvXXJra0cVz28CvACfr2Ov7Z4E-BsswKtBgNeTAJ84Um1XIgH-4Pcb5frVZMaNqsSNCgesMuK5F24k_z3Cipxl_SonXQJ8V9xyvDglruZW-9yQ01-V9l_9Tgd_AgAA__-F-YN2) that resonates with older Americans, many of whom recall the chain's vintage restaurants. More than one in five respondents skipped the national chains entirely and chose a local or regional pizzeria.

body:
President Trump upended the Texas Republican Senate race Tuesday, endorsing Attorney General Ken Paxton over incumbent Sen. John Cornyn just one week before the May 26 runoff--[a move that caught](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFugzAQgOGnMZuROXAMg4cubOnaERl8TqwaG9mXkLx9Be0bdDvppP_03dd1uhoffLx9mhU1vVyaIu4lIBHmifJj3TDalAuWzbwoxQ0jmdsEAi5cSA5issaH99RVVs_CDk2FulFqACWFkNVdY9cpBdIoVH2_LIMdZgBAHLpL05jFVl4fMSFBNI1ooa3V7PrB9VIpOau27Vkn0HpKuaY7Er5MceGdnpjrJa1V0HeirbD2g8HIYNz3vV7mciiOPYPxGBmMJ4Z_Y-S_Ev4HWzESP7O8YDSEPD9ico7BWGVtt92H4MtFsU7cVuPDeZX-96unhp8AAAD__4mAgII) Cornyn off guard after months of uncertainty.

| | |
---
| [](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0M_q4yAQwPGnMbeWicaYHDwslN661z2KiZNE0Cg66Z-3X1q67AP8bgOfYRi-f27mZn3w-_rbRtT0XJLZ8VEDEmExVI6YcXepVKzZPintGXeyq-HA-xPIEwfjrA8v0zVOT-DGtkHdKjVyJQFks2lo-cwnFINTTmA3g5vRilGC6_tpsNB4_T4GkkPbguDirKZlGJdBKiUnJcTAOkDnKZUzbUj4tHUJr3THcp5TbILeiHJl4hfjV8av_4w2zOkonzmV9Y3ielA0NR1lRiYutOF3mfH-LRGdPyITl_8JvjLbmK1fdyYulSyhifZlODRFu_zwIfjaK9bBGq0Pn6_oZy3vmv8NAAD__7ZxjGc) | |
# Wednesday, May 20, 2026
---|---
**Good morning!** On this day in 1862, President Abraham Lincoln [signed the Homestead Act](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDHPpCAQQH8NdhocBKSguMZur73SjMuoJCgG5tbdf3_Z-wtf__Je8v485gfGFM_tNx7k-b3m-aS7JmKmMnP5e1x0hlwq1QvfnM-LTsZtBgmmlboFOQeM6TMPTfCLDK5vyPfWOrBaSt3sXmoy_QDBGWcxKBukWtWXCIacM9RE_5VJDbLvpQLV2WUd3Tpqa_VilRrFIClEzqXjnZjeWNf0yS8q3TMfTfI781WF-iVgEjDd990tyJxojZRC7XLZBEyJsJwCJiwcn4mqgGnPB1UmDC0-ue1HA03x4bpjSrEaKwa5HRjT_wr_7M3Lw78AAAD__6kjeNc). name: Lauren Toncich, Turning Point USA
subject: We cannot surrender young women to the Left
body:
I’ve been wanting to write you about this
For years, the Left thought they had a permanent grip on America's youth.

| | | | [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=25b72dfaf34949f78883fdca330fc849&_e=4oJH3hRYtXMhy2yoze2FU92MQZ416sufBsDSY9DR94CosiYxCdYBJo0UkTbFRRV751Lfhx-8aW-1LGhxQcyEjRJVcukltdIufFkUrENDkw_qr-AQ0PywBor8FVslQFWGsRbEf4fLhKV0CwPyHjtJcWa6O35w5LG_BU_AyDL3lYLIJ2z6DjBdJZmLpVhTv0NOAqX3KgAEgvqekoH5rDDEau9CvEJtEP_-qdto25C6sQx8MmzcfH-Agp9_jhIf_5Vx-nXH3yVfiTrGhMuE0w0IWxhszXvhpu0Foljdr8MpKFmjJKx3IUolnzFe-oS0MJpXGOD01t8O0upyR0A_WkkGtEtQuWSurHSPkJ6SENuOVKbbM5EMb7b2cYHNRPYGoWBNPrIBQbID4t10WVK0LdFV1IcW6wSqUGEIdp3nafgIG74STudqu_wCeqQpTrkSiXxJCReLlabzidaDI_Q2Y9Kxpjao-Rc3kzqNHzP77Cxrtep9LLoN6m8zh3xNExGgwSv7KzayfF43Qu2rUVXS9eeIyqMYKze4IyvsuUIJ0p4eTQjDLrv9LpBh_CVEKPX--RBcO87qFQuuVZYJM9wLVc8r6MPkxmLADCGARBeV_JxtldOQ93v6TftJdjO-6345cgGCW4QDWxzt6Ww1qZ9lDNUIJdgIHThvFhLqXNt9GdilMz2OOM8wFOtEXTQgbBWi1UrE)
---
| | | Peter,
---
For years, the Left thought they had a permanent grip on America's youth.

And honestly?

For a while, they did.
They dominated classrooms. Social media. Pop culture. Hollywood. Universities.

They told an entire generation that loving your country was shameful...

That faith was outdated... And traditional values were something to erase.

But thanks to Charlie's leadership, something incredible has happened:

Young men are rejecting the Left in RECORD numbers. High school boys are the most Conservative they've been in 50 years.

And Gen Z is heading back to church -- in numbers greater than their parents' or grandparents' generations.

For the first time in decades, we are WINNING the American Culture War.

**But there 's still one group the Left is desperately fighting to hold onto: **

_America 's young women. _

Because they know something very important, Peter...

If they can win the hearts and minds of young women...

They don't just shape individuals. They shape families. They shape homes. They shape future generations.

**And that 's exactly why Turning Point USA's Women's Leadership Summit (WLS) matters more than ever this year. **
---
[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=25b72dfaf34949f78883fdca330fc849&_e=4oJH3hRYtXMhy2yoze2FU92MQZ416sufBsDSY9DR94CosiYxCdYBJo0UkTbFRRV751Lfhx-8aW-1LGhxQcyEjRJVcukltdIufFkUrENDkw_qr-AQ0PywBor8FVslQFWGsRbEf4fLhKV0CwPyHjtJcWa6O35w5LG_BU_AyDL3lYLIJ2z6DjBdJZmLpVhTv0NOAqX3KgAEgvqekoH5rDDEau9CvEJtEP_-qdto25C6sQzW49Z2gCxlt96puAPHcbyd9YoD7REyS2ln2mfjJyVFjMnnibqRiEW_d17rdBdYecQ6qeOtUbQEydER4e_JuXPu5jEiwGmwnlakWY9BDDBVNULjXi7pGgjVmzUskTZslXsCQ9TfzH9wGvghbw_ENrIGTmTEb5Ek1tQzewOPT4x-Qzzp44rrKcSBNpD1FuDiXgjMARVv5Bq67dMtLBcLd7JTxcplg98BaGwB1LJsVkQNOQtJ1IXSwfo3jh4en8DxVZ4O5YML6uYe3Rm86ET5vNF2S8vXxHoS516usREsgDiwFBXRecGQqZlZMj7taN2REp3f8i4ZC0BjWcvXgHtFLBeuWB6g1nH20KG6oa9EHmyX48XDTerz-F80y_W2t9E9k9e2R8-ZjGKnkpEAC0WCusu_9m_d4b6PxgPsbFezcSEEvGnKFlt5aLkkzJFsGc64S-3MSnzaMt0ma9PsDpfKcRUo)
---
I've spent the last 7 years helping lead the team behind Turning Point USA's biggest events.

And I can honestly tell you:

I've never seen young women hungrier for truth, purpose, faith, wellness, and real community than they are right now.

Because modern culture is failing them.

The Left sold them confusion and called it "empowerment."

They told young women: femininity is weakness, motherhood is oppression, faith is foolish, patriotism is toxic, and healthy living is extremism.

And after years of hearing those lies...

So many young women feel exhausted. Lonely. Anxious. Spiritually empty.

They're searching for something REAL.

Somewhere they can breathe again. Somewhere they can grow stronger instead of being torn down.

_That 's what Women's Leadership Summit has become. _

Not just another event... but a place where thousands of women come together to rediscover truth, confidence, purpose, and courage.

**From June 5 -7 in San Antonio, women from across the country will gather to: **

✅ Strengthen their minds
✅ Cultivate wellness
✅ Step boldly into their purpose
✅ Anchor their spirits in faith

And when they walk into that room... _Something changes. _
---
[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=25b72dfaf34949f78883fdca330fc849&_e=4oJH3hRYtXMhy2yoze2FU92MQZ416sufBsDSY9DR94CosiYxCdYBJo0UkTbFRRV751Lfhx-8aW-1LGhxQcyEjRJVcukltdIufFkUrENDkw_qr-AQ0PywBor8FVslQFWGsRbEf4fLhKV0CwPyHjtJcWa6O35w5LG_BU_AyDL3lYLIJ2z6DjBdJZmLpVhTv0NOAqX3KgAEgvqekoH5rDDEau9CvEJtEP_-qdto25C6sQyOWrv73DyWMirNj8F--DwzBDezvpMwMHohSxIn3UGdb66WlAbaxNYlEWzWh0Ko_GlIp8N-eKBkQ9orZcYxnR-I-p4-E7xAEkHouzqrX7JdprYMCopEhv_ceRnE3YcXnmmPbqbTKEATwL9iB_ek6xMBS9lWyMvfzkqwjANnk8DFTPlg2ZA9T6wUtiYRgMyHFWZUBHcIFmnzjt5Avlf-8XvZkcHNOHdVQjkmttyATh7r_ejL6aUUhTzXrcaqABVlHY7juWMikJ_Ee1p4gncL7e3C9ERKsXtlmdiTETyEazY-CwDhW1_RdZaXv69RAGMvjVEv_mRrJH3TFUnM_ch2Lts_wiRdUH-m5acW_kA7AketRJZi9qVuoaN4rcWOv0Ve_7n3-iJ9LU1I0GVPTtL5fZ1-B0AcHU7LWl8db_4j7TcKb8fw3g8r91DspXoizQ7GDtxRg7wMkIv7mdEv9qWlsUM7)
---
Peter, I see it happen every year -- and from backstage, you can actually watch the change happen in real time.

Young women arriving unsure of themselves...

_Then leaving with fire in their eyes. _

Women who thought they were alone suddenly realizing:

_" There are thousands of other women who love God, love Freedom, and LOVE AMERICA just like I do." _

That matters.

Because the Left wants these young women isolated.

Disconnected. Demoralized. Easy to manipulate.

But WLS reminds them they are part of something MUCH bigger.

**A movement. A sisterhood. A generation of strong, patriotic women rising up to reject the lies they 've been fed for years. **

And these women don't just leave inspired... _They go home ready to LEAD. _

I've watched women leave WLS and:

🔥 Strengthen their faith
🔥 Embrace their femininity
🔥 Build friendships rooted in truth and purpose
🔥 Boldly speak out on their campuses
🔥 Launch Turning Point USA chapters
🔥 Lead in their communities and in this movement

This is how we WIN the culture war. One fearless young woman at a time.
---
[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=25b72dfaf34949f78883fdca330fc849&_e=4oJH3hRYtXMhy2yoze2FU92MQZ416sufBsDSY9DR94CosiYxCdYBJo0UkTbFRRV751Lfhx-8aW-1LGhxQcyEjRJVcukltdIufFkUrENDkw_qr-AQ0PywBor8FVslQFWGsRbEf4fLhKV0CwPyHjtJcWa6O35w5LG_BU_AyDL3lYLIJ2z6DjBdJZmLpVhTv0NOAqX3KgAEgvqekoH5rDDEau9CvEJtEP_-qdto25C6sQwyXcnjoqEpco1CJHtgleGwdDmwLcVSeCpkfTn19wqohQBAcSTx4LhlbQpoxfRYF8g3yrnGO-e4lTZivfzq2t4HfjD_p1mecrrGtbZa0fj5vBycNCsdypmmrD6ZHnGTzaw_RgKKMwDNj0Z-o3y9sYzR0Or4e0pNX1XsmF1NLbGa08U1xoEVykO-lA_DzRjf8_5fauNsJzhLUdwHVMRT-js8PMZhNPHeBNMaU5C_h5yASuYJj3XLi-6dOjw0hhuZBWZMY1Lg2OmPBBcHt3HU-fMVutkmtLaNN7Zgj7QsX16DPf29PDaiQxkjHAgrYcJC4wr83UlWWF5JrfA9Yr4aKnOy6H9NGShpZNnamO9yzfNuHve97MyEans4630vTAmY0I4_xLYo_NVi50kEe-yO_zUYBbqddUmfkTttmMCglLL5SGpbBnJvNVPMpSCYU-sFX0Pu0XUGyVc6JOcyRCUr1_pF)
---
_But here 's the problem, Peter... _

Right now, we have many young women who desperately want to attend WLS but may miss this life-changing experience without help.

Some are students working to save enough money for gas or airfare.

While the election results were not what we wanted, I refuse to call this a complete loss...

| | | | | [|

| | | | | | Peter,

While last night’s election results did not go the way we had hoped, I want to thank every single one of you who stood with me in our fight for Pennsylvania’s future.

I want to thank all of the volunteers who knocked on doors, made phone calls, delivered yard signs, and showed up to events. You poured your time and energy into this campaign because you believe in a better Pennsylvania, and your hard work and dedication meant more to me than you will ever know.

I also want to thank everyone who donated to my campaign. Although we hoped to give you a better return on your investment right away, please know that your contributions made a real difference. They helped us get our message out and hold Lisa Baker accountable on the issues that matter most.

While the election results were not what we wanted, I refuse to call this a complete loss. Because we called out Lisa Baker on her weak record on the Second Amendment, she was forced to hold a hearing on Constitutional Carry. That never would have happened without the pressure we put on her.

We are hopeful that Lisa Baker will now do more to fight for the families, farms, and wallets of Northeastern Pennsylvania. If she does not, she will be seeing another challenge from me in four years.

This fight is far from over. I will continue to stay engaged in any way I can and do my part to build a brighter and more prosperous future for our children and our communities.

Pennsylvania deserves strong conservative leadership in Harrisburg, and I remain committed to that fight.

Thank you again for believing in me and for everything you gave to this campaign. I am truly humbled and grateful.

Let’s keep fighting for the values that make Pennsylvania great!

For Pennsylvania,

Peter,
---
It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. **But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250****th**** birthday.**

Peter, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. clean_body: It's Gary Sinise here. | | | | Peter, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Peter, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Peter, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. | | | | | | | | This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. Peter, thank you for your support of America 's heroes. Sincerely, Tim Holbert President American Veterans Center | | | The mission of the American Veterans Center and the World War II Veterans Committee is to preserve and promote the legacy and experiences of America's veterans and active duty service personnel from World War II through today. Peter,
We lost the Georgia Supreme Court election last night.
Jen Jordan and Miracle Rankin ran with courage against a stacked deck: a GOP-controlled commission that attacked them on Election Day, incumbents backed by Governor Kemp's dark money, and a national right-wing machine that has been building toward this moment for thirty years.
We are grateful for their bravery in taking on this machine and devastated they came up short. But we don't have time to lick our wounds--we need to get back to work. Because MAGA is on the march:

In the past few days, MAGA defeated Republicans Bill Cassidy and Thomas Massie in their primary elections for daring to stand up to Trump. This follows MAGA's Indiana victories punishing state legislators who refused to go along with the election-rigging gerrymandering scheme.
Trump is historically unpopular. Protests are erupting. Every week brings new corruption so brazen it would have ended any previous presidency. The conditions for a historic Democratic wave exist. But the blue wave in November is not inevitable. We have to make it happen.
What happened last night in Georgia is proof. A stacked court, a stacked commission, a governor calling special redistricting sessions, Leonard Leo's dark money flooding the final stretch -- all of it worked together to hold the line for MAGA regardless of the will of voters.
Trump doesn't need to be popular. He just needs to control the courts. And right now, he does. This is exactly why the work of Defend our Courts is critical.
The Georgia loss is a major setback. But it will not stop us. We are 2-1. We have beaten Leo's machine before. We will beat it again -- in the November Supreme Court elections, in the 2026 midterms, and in the fight to reform the Supreme Court via our Unpack our Courts initiative. But only if we double down right now. Not next week. Today.
We cannot afford to lose another state supreme court race. subject: Peter, I want to tell you a quick story.
body:
I fought for our teachers and students as Governor, and I promise to fight for them in the Senate.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6532?source=&t=1&akid=1479%2E124072%2EpXMt4n)
| | | |
---
Peter, it’s Roy Cooper. I want to tell you a quick story.
When I was a young boy, my grandmother passed away. I still went to school that morning, bearing the weight of the news, and I thought nobody would know or care that much about what had just happened.
**Still when I got to my classroom, my third-grade teacher, Mrs. Batchelor, greeted me with a hug at the door. She already knew about it and told me how sorry she was. That small gesture meant the world to me.**
I think about that day all these years later. Teachers are so much more than educators. They’re the heart of every community – there for you during good days and bad, five days a week – and they deserve to be treated as such.
I fought for our teachers and students as Governor of North Carolina, and I promise to fight for them in the U.S. Senate – but first, I need your help to get there.

Peter, on this day in 1993, the National Voter Registration Act was signed into law. This bipartisan bill made it easier for the American people to register to vote by allowing them to register when they got their driver's license.

A lot of people say, _**"Does my one vote even matter?**_ " It absolutely does. When people come together and turn out to vote, they have the power to create change in their community.

Each vote plays a part in determining the future of our country, and the more people who cast their ballot, the more likely our shared values and issues are prioritized. When we don't vote, we essentially give up our voice for what kind of government we want.

_**Why else do you think extremists like Mariannette Miller-Meeks are trying to do everything they can to drown out our collective voice?**_

subject: Thank you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Ossoff for Senate
body:
# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=2281%2E5691347%2E0Nb1pd)

_Thank you, Georgia!_
After last night’s primary, I am officially the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Georgia.
This race in Georgia is likely to be the most competitive and expensive U.S. Senate race in 2026. I am the *only* endangered Democratic incumbent U.S. Senator in the midterms. Republicans are preparing to unleash massive resources attacking me and this seat.
But our victory will be powered once again by overwhelming grassroots support.
If you know the stakes and how important your support is — and if you are ready to make a donation to help start the general election in the strongest position possible — please use this link: [**https://act.electjon.com/go/General-Election**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-may26.KE07xH&refcode=em260520-1-f&t=2&akid=2281%2E5691347%2E0Nb1pd)
Otherwise, let me tell you a bit about why I ran for Senate — and why this moment is just as urgent.
Before I was elected, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. We exposed wrongdoing in countries where criticizing the government is dangerous, where whistleblowers and witnesses will only meet in secret, where protest carries the risk of prosecution.
More and more, the atmosphere under Trump has reminded me of those places — places where dissent was silenced by intimidation and where unaccountable elites plunder and trade power for profit with impunity.
I ran for Senate because I saw that Trump’s election endangered our Republic and I was determined to confront him and the corruption that made his rise possible.
_And Peter, that work isn’t over yet._
**This is not a drill and it’s not a bad dream. As citizens, it’s the test of our lifetimes.**
So please, I’m humbly asking: [**Make a contribution to my reelection campaign. Do it today and help us start the general election in the strongest possible position.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-may26.KE07xH&refcode=em260520-1-f&t=3&akid=2281%2E5691347%2E0Nb1pd)
**[DONATE NOW](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-may26.KE07xH&refcode=em260520-1-f&t=4&akid=2281%2E5691347%2E0Nb1pd)**
We know MAGA’s election playbook: _Lie. Enrage. Distract._
And between the Fulton County raid, the executive order attacking voting, and the plotting of the MAGA loyalists on our state election board... they've made their plans very clear.
But we’ve beaten them before — _right here in Georgia._
In 2021, we defeated an entrenched GOP incumbent by staying on offense and organizing a turnout effort totally unprecedented in its scale and intensity.
**This is the next test.**
And the best insurance against MAGA’s dirty tricks is _landslide margins of victory._
My team is preparing a larger-than-ever-before effort to get out the vote and defend voting rights.
That work is not easy or cheap. We have to work relentlessly through Election Day, and we need the resources to reach every single voter.
[**Peter, I have to ask: Can you please make a donation to my reelection campaign and help us start the general election strong?**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-may26.KE07xH&refcode=em260520-1-f&t=5&akid=2281%2E5691347%2E0Nb1pd)
The average donation to this campaign is around $30. Many give less. Some give more. **What matters is that we show strength in numbers — _and that we show it now._**
**[DONATE](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-may26.KE07xH&refcode=em260520-1-f&t=6&akid=2281%2E5691347%2E0Nb1pd)**
Thank you so much.
\- Jon
[](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-may26.KE07xH&refcode=em260520-1-f&refcode2=2281.5691347.0Nb1pd&t=7&akid=2281%2E5691347%2E0Nb1pd)

Email is a critical way to keep up with Jon and his work in the US Senate, but you can click [here](https://act.electjon.com/signup/fewer-emails-signup/?t=8&akid=2281%2E5691347%2E0Nb1pd) to sign up to receive fewer emails, or click [here](https://act.electjon.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=9&akid=2281%2E5691347%2E0Nb1pd) if you'd like to unsubscribe.

subject: Thank you!
body:
I’m honored and humbled by your support.
| | | | | [](https://a89bm49ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001vGTBWM0AQxjSJxcLzxGTMbJEdfPiipyylCPfvEWUS6CO6fuui7KZieDSIuv43ZPnh8o1PP67NSvCLgTn9_KFr7qk9n8UqbfJFn833QLeBn7m2MrD0s9TZdjf9Ix1Q6pIlUeFsPvwISI5bAoGMMuEwVpDVeTNGmU8&c=HvJS2q6zcwD8CfESv0-MgTjxICtyvrtRjYcSEqQyZNeNWj77_DnRmw==&ch=TTVRYFVRIVWSEVAuu_iG3SlzilUbNEuoUuryCC7lh0qqM2oTZTqhbQ==)
---
| What a night--Thank you! I'm honored and humbled to have earned the Republican nomination for Georgia's 10th Congressional District.
I'm grateful to the voters of our district for their trust, support, and belief in our campaign. I also want to thank my opponents for a hard-fought race. Running for office is not easy, and I appreciate their willingness to step forward.
Most importantly, my thanks to you and all who supported our campaign with your prayers, encouragement, time, and resources. From our incredible campaign staff to the hundreds of county captains, interns, and volunteers across the 10th District, we built a grassroots movement and outworked everybody.
I especially want to thank my family -- my parents (my mom knocked on thousands of doors, and my dad was my unpaid driver!) and my siblings -- and most importantly, my wife, Gabi. Nobody sacrifices more during a campaign than a candidate's spouse, and I'm incredibly grateful she's been by my side every step of the way.
---
| | | |
---
As an 8th-generation Northeast Georgian born and raised here in Athens, it has been the honor of my life to serve you in the Georgia House. I've been proud of what we've accomplished, and I'm proud of my record delivering real results. Now, I'm ready to take that fight to Washington. Frankly, Washington is broken because too many politicians go there to become celebrities. I'm going there to get to work.

Let's be the clear: the primary is not the finish line. We'll take today off, but very quickly we will get back to work because we have a general election to win in November. Just this week, a national publication wrote [an article](https://a89bm49ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001vGTBWM0AQxjSJxcLzxGTMbJEdfPiipyylCPfvEWUS6CO6fuui7KZiT3KLeSJ6dkguwzBB1Zs58pKBwPPfNYzjPq8kfjU55GQRnSG7Vo_IcLHkbGPE1tKn3fM7iwbP0l_xalgX1ZgpG9dFmbJ83IUzxu_sMHdCcrljX01gLJlm-gsPIqLShANOKcd9crTk7W0&c=HvJS2q6zcwD8CfESv0-MgTjxICtyvrtRjYcSEqQyZNeNWj77_DnRmw==&ch=TTVRYFVRIVWSEVAuu_iG3SlzilUbNEuoUuryCC7lh0qqM2oTZTqhbQ==) about this race, saying "circumstances are ripe for a flip come November." While I can tell you that we won't let that happen, the stakes are too high for our country to slow down now.

But today I simply want to say Thank You. Thank you for believing in our campaign. Thank you for being a friend and supporter throughout this process. I look forward to continue serving our community.

Your friend,
Houston
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| P.S. - If you have a yard sign, feel free to put the sign away until August, and then we'll put them back out for the general election. We are going to work over the next couple of weeks to do the same with our larger signs.
---
| | | | Gaines for Congress | P.O. Box 48013 | Athens, GA 30604 US

About whether the father would disappear if she kept the baby. About how alone she felt carrying a secret she didn’t know how to tell anyone. And like so many women today, she was being pushed toward abortion before anyone had even shown her her baby. The entire system is built around speed. Move fast. Don’t think too long. Solve the problem before the emotions catch up. A chance to be heard.

name: Chris Murphy
subject: I am personally asking
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
The minute they perceive us to be weak is the minute they will pounce.
#

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260520-1-b&t=1&akid=11484%2E3935704%2EH-NDRU)
---
Friends, it’s Senator Chris Murphy. My good friend, Gabby Giffords, wanted me to reach out.
I was proud to help lead the fight in 2022 for the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act — the most important national gun law in decades.**But it was your efforts as part of this grassroots movement alongside GIFFORDS that got that bill across the line and signed into law.**
I saw this firsthand. Republicans were forced to realize that our movement was — and remains — more powerful than the gun lobby.
This month marks the fourth anniversary of the horrific tragedy in Uvalde. During those 30 days between the shooting and the passage of the law, our movement owned the media space, shaped the debate in Washington, and dominated the phone lines.
YOU made this happen — and that is how we passed a law that has already saved countless lives.
**Today, we must apply these same lessons to our fight to stop the Trump administration from rolling back our hard-fought progress.**
Since President Trump retook the White House, he’s shown time and time again that he cares more about the corporate gun industry’s profits than our communities’ safety.
He disbanded the White House Office of Gun Violence Prevention. He ordered a review of the gun safety measures we fought for and won during the Biden-Harris administration — including overwhelmingly popular actions to expand background checks. And every day, his administration is pulling every lever they can to enrich their gun industry allies.
Our job is to flood the zone just like they’re doing — to rebut their lies, correct the record, and remind Americans why the daily epidemic of gun violence is happening.
**And we must put the White House and the gun lobby on the defensive about why they want more families to experience the trauma of gun violence firsthand.**
We have to be in this fight every single day. I am not taking a day off in our efforts to fight back against Trump and the gun lobby, and I hope you won’t either. Because GIFFORDS needs you now more than ever.
**[If you can, please make a contribution to support GIFFORDS PAC’s efforts to fight for a world free from gun violence. Whatever you can spare will help them hold the gun industry accountable.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260520-1-b&t=2&akid=11484%2E3935704%2EH-NDRU)

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

### Weekly Volunteer Virtual Meetings

Join Team Kinter and help us build a people-powered movement for Florida's 7th Congressional District. Marialana Kinter is fighting for working families, affordable living, and a government that puts people before corporate interests. We need volunteers like you to help make it happen. We're inviting supporters to sign up for our weekly volunteer meetings, where you can learn how to get involved through canvassing, phone banking, community outreach, digital organizing, and more. This week, our volunteer meeting time has been moved up to 6:00 PM instead of 7:00 PM. We also now have new volunteer committees so supporters can plug in where their skills and passions fit best. Our committees include Press and Media, Data and Precinct Captains, Administrative and Research, Events, and Tabling. When you sign up, you can share your availability, skills, and the ways you'd like to support the campaign. You can also request a campaign shirt and get connected with the volunteer opportunities that best fit you.
* Wednesday, May 20th at 6 PM
* Please take a few minutes to fill out the form and become part of the movement for real change in District 7. If you have any questions, contact us at [lee@kinterforcongress.com](mailto:lee@kinterforcongress.com).

Friends,
Last night, I conceded the race for Governor of Georgia.
While this was not the outcome we hoped for, I want you to know how deeply grateful I am for your support, your encouragement, and the trust you placed in me throughout this campaign.
You have been with me every step of the way. Whether you volunteered your time, made a contribution, hosted an event, put up a yard sign, said a prayer, or simply shared our message with friends and neighbors, your support means more to me than you will ever know.
Campaigns are about people. Over the course of this race, I had the privilege of meeting hardworking Georgians in every corner of our state who love this country, care about their communities, and want a brighter future for their children and grandchildren. That gives me tremendous hope.
While I will not be Georgia’s next Governor, I have no doubt that our state’s best days are still ahead.
I will finish my term as Secretary of State strong and continue serving in the ways that matter most to me — through my church, my community, and by remaining engaged in the future of our state.
Thank you for standing with me. Thank you for believing in this campaign. Thank you for fighting for a safer, more affordable Georgia.
I am forever grateful for your support, your prayers, and your friendship.

name: Freedom 250
subject: You’re Invited: Memorial Day Evening Observance at Arlington @ 8:30 PM ET
body:
Join Freedom 250 for a National Memorial Day Observance
An evening of stories, service, remembrance, and unity at Arlington National Cemetery on May 25, 2026.
| [](https://link.win.donaldjtrump._g/s2h5c742eeb)
---
Freedom 250
# You're Invited
National Memorial Day Observance: An Evening of Stories of Service
—◆— Join Us for a Historic Evening
**May 25, 2026 | Doors 6 p.m. ET | Program 8:30 p.m. ET**
Dear Friend, Freedom 250 invites you to join us for the **Freedom 250 National Memorial Day Observance: An Evening of Stories of Service** at the Memorial Amphitheater at Arlington National Cemetery. | [RSVP Now](https://link.win.donaldjtrump._g/s7qa10a6138)
---
| [](https://link.win.donaldjtrump._g/s2l47140d55)
---
This solemn evening program will create a reflective national moment of remembrance, service, and unity. Through candlelit storytelling, music, and historically grounded profiles, the observance will honor the courage and sacrifice represented at Arlington and across the American story.
[Special Appearance](https://link.win.donaldjtrump._g/setfc481f22) [Featuring Grammy Award winning performer, Gretchen Wilson as part of this meaningful evening of remembrance, service, and unity.](https://link.win.donaldjtrump._g/s3jec811e6c)
---
Event Details
---
**Monday, May 25, 2026**
Doors open at 6 p.m. ET; the program begins at 8:30 p.m. ET.
Memorial Amphitheater at Arlington National Cemetery

This solemn public evening observance will gather Americans for a reflective national moment following the official daytime Memorial Day observances.
An Evening of Stories of Service
---
The program is designed as a candlelit storytelling experience centered on remembrance, service, and unity. Through carefully selected narratives, the evening will honor individual acts of heroism and broader moments of national sacrifice represented at Arlington.
Stories of Grit, Valor, and Lifelong Service
---
Featured profiles will include Captain Humbert Roque “Rocky” Versace of the U.S. Army and Captain Daniel W. Eggers of the U.S. Army Special Forces, whose lives reflect courage, sacrifice, leadership, and enduring service to others. | [Learn More](https://link.win.donaldjtrump._g/s6l06f783ef)
---
As America approaches its 250th anniversary, this Memorial Day observance is an opportunity to pause with gratitude, remember those who gave their lives in service, and renew our shared commitment to honor their sacrifice.
We hope you will join Freedom 250 for this meaningful evening of remembrance.
[RSVP Now](https://link.win.donaldjtrump._g/sdmda81e1dc)
---
With gratitude,
The Freedom 250 Team
|

---

[1]Justice Democrats

BREAKING news, Peter:

Justice Democrat Chris Rabb won the Democratic primary for Pennsylvania’s
3rd congressional district by over 10 points in a landslide!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260520-1.nGjid5&refcode=em20260520-37797&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=37797%2E1203867%2Eh1yhBI ]Congratulations PA-03 Primary 2026 WINNER Justice Democrat Chris Rabb

huge win for our progressive movement nationwide. Instead of electing an
establishment pick, the people of Philadelphia chose to send a bold,
progressive leader to represent the bluest district in the country. It’s
about time!

Chris will now join Rep. Summer Lee as the second Justice Democrat from PA
in Congress, and we couldn’t be more proud.

Despite being up against over $3 million in spending primarily from 314
Action Fund — a PAC previously used by AIPAC as a pass-through — Chris and
his people-powered team out-organized his opposition to build the broadest
coalition of local leaders, grassroots organizations, and national
progressives to win this race.

From the very beginning, Chris ran an uncompromising campaign to end
pay-to-play politics and build a government that answers to its voters,
not billionaires and corporate lobbyists.

And unlike his opponents, he never shied away from calling what Israel is
doing in Gaza a genocide, and proudly rejected contributions from AIPAC
and corporate PACs.

Chris is exactly what Democratic voters nationwide are demanding —
progressive trailblazers who fight for their communities, not just when
it's politically convenient but when it's morally necessary.

While the party machine has spent decades failing to meet the needs of its
voters, Chris has taken the fight to corporate interests, billionaire
CEOs, and Republican extremists his whole career.

Anchored by grassroots organizing on the ground from Pittsburgh to Philly,
together alongside Summer Lee and Chris Rabb, we are ensuring a new,
powerful progressive movement leads Pennsylvania towards the future it
deserves.

Meet Senator Lee:

**Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution.

This is why I do this.
[Thomas Massie ](https://substack.com/redirect/2d7c20f8-b201-4eeb-9b9a-b660a1d494a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)just lost his Republican primary to a Trump-endorsed challenger. President Trump's endorsed candidates dominated across several races, and Massie's loss showed, once again, how tightly Trump controls the Republican Party.
Please Support The Angry Democrat
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..BlqPJetJzrlFzpkcFOyCdMyfu9Di0_znCnPcjtU6lPE?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=198570595)
But this is bigger than one Republican primary in Kentucky.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/26a0ea38-c573-4111-9cb8-f2b0ed8c7c96?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Congressman Tom Massie](https://substack.com/redirect/2d7c20f8-b201-4eeb-9b9a-b660a1d494a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I do not have to agree with Massie on every issue to see the warning. He was one of the few Republicans willing to break with his party, question power, push uncomfortable issues, and refuse to be a rubber stamp. He supported releasing the Epstein files. He questioned government surveillance. He challenged his own side when he thought they were wrong. He took positions that did not always fit neatly inside party loyalty.
And now he is gone.
I do not know if Massie was the canary in the coal mine, or if the mine had already collapsed and crushed the canary.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b7c9a494-7dc8-4668-b407-af4a036d04c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
That should bother Democrats. Not because Massie was one of us. It should bother us because it shows what happens when party loyalty replaces independent thought. It shows what happens when asking questions becomes an act of betrayal.
I do not want that for the Democratic Party.
I am a Democrat because I believe this party can still be the party of accountability, transparency, working people, civil rights, democracy, and actual public service. I believe the Democratic Party can be the party that takes the hard questions seriously instead of running from them. But that only happens if we are willing to have the conversations that party insiders, consultants, donors, and power brokers would sometimes rather avoid.
These conversations should not be controversial.
Releasing the Epstein files should not be controversial. Banning congressional stock trading should not be controversial. Questioning surveillance should not be controversial. Asking whether representatives should serve their constituents instead of their president, their party, their donors, or their leadership should not be controversial. Saying no more forever wars should not be controversial.
But somehow, it is.
That is why The Angry Democrat exists.
Please Support The Angry Democrat
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..BlqPJetJzrlFzpkcFOyCdMyfu9Di0_znCnPcjtU6lPE?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=198570595)
This is not about tearing down the Democratic Party. It is about making sure the Democratic Party does not become a place where independent thought gets punished, where internal criticism gets labeled disloyal, and where difficult conversations are buried because they make people uncomfortable.
We can still be Democrats and ask hard questions.
We can still support the party and demand better from it.
We can still fight Republicans in November while also refusing to ignore corruption, insider politics, and institutional rot.
[The Angry Democrat](https://open.substack.com/users/102996536-the-angry-democrat?utm_source=mentions), along with [The Angry Ohioan](https://open.substack.com/pub/theangryohioan?utm_source=mentions), exists to keep these conversations alive.
Your support helps me keep covering national Democratic politics, local Northeast Ohio races, party operations, campaign finance, corruption, and the issues that too often get ignored until it is too late.
Please Support The Angry Democrat
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..BlqPJetJzrlFzpkcFOyCdMyfu9Di0_znCnPcjtU6lPE?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=198570595)
If you believe the Democratic Party should be strong enough to handle scrutiny, honest enough to confront its own problems, and serious enough to have the hard conversations before the cave-in comes for us too, please consider supporting this work.
We need clarity heading into 2026 and 2028.
We need courage.
We need a Democratic party for the people and the USA.
Please support The Angry Democrat.
