However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | Drowning in credit card interest? name: Squad Victory Fund
subject: When dissent is treated like a threat
body:
[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/18910?refcode=em20260520-2283-foote&t=1001&akid=2283%2E342411%2EvPITN- ]Squad Victory Fund

Peter,

The Trump administration is pushing a dangerous message: if you speak out,
protest injustice, defend immigrants, stand up for LGBTQ+ communities, or
challenge their abuses of power — they’ll come after you.

And Alexandria, Ayanna, Ilhan, and Rashida are directly in their sights.

The Squad has never stopped fighting for working people and marginalized
communities, no matter how vicious the attacks become. They’ve spoken out
against Trump’s cruelty, defended our civil rights, demanded
accountability, and refused to stay silent while extremists try to drag
this country backward.

Now, the threats against them are escalating.

Violent rhetoric fueled by MAGA extremists and amplified by Trump’s allies
has made simply doing this work more dangerous than ever. These threats
don’t just put the Squad at risk — they put their families, staff, and
entire communities in danger too.

And while Republicans and right-wing media continue to demonize
progressive leaders, the Squad is being forced to spend enormous resources
on security just to safely continue doing their jobs.

That means money that should be spent organizing, mobilizing, and fighting
for working people is instead going toward basic protection.

But the Squad refuses to be intimidated. They’re showing up every day to
fight for justice, equality, dignity, and a future where everyone — no
matter their background — can thrive.

And in this moment, they need us to stand with them.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260520-movement.qU_JLZ&refcode=em20260520-2283&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=2283%2E342411%2EvPITN- ]If you can, please chip in $3 or anything you’re able to
the Squad Victory Fund today to help protect our four progressive
champions so they can keep organizing, speaking out, and fighting for the
people who count on them most.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260520-movement.qU_JLZ&refcode=em20260520-2283&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=2283%2E342411%2EvPITN- ]Contribute ››

In solidarity,

The Squad Victory Fund

Contributions to The Squad Victory Fund will be allocated equally among: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, Rashida Tlaib for Congress, Courage to Change, Inspiring Leadership Has a Name PAC, Power of Us PAC, and Rooted in Community Leadership PAC.

Any contributor may designate their contribution for a particular participant. The allocation formula above may change if any contributor makes a contribution that, when allocated, would exceed the amount that the contributor may lawfully give to any participant.

After contributing to The Squad Victory Fund, you will automatically be signed up to receive email updates from Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, and Rashida Tlaib for Congress. You may of course opt-out by unsubscribing at any time.

| Peter,
In this past Saturday's elections Louisiana voters delivered a shocking defeat to MAGA in what used to be their own backyard.
Voters defeated all five of the statewide amendments being pushed by our MAGA governor by over 20% of the vote.
And in the US Senate race, the Louisiana Democratic Party's endorsed candidate, Jamie Davis, advanced into the runoff where he is expected to have a good shot at beating the GOP candidate in the general election this November.
This was the first election since the rollback of the legislation that ended Jim Crow, the Voting Rights Act, and voters made themselves heard:
---
| | [](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001l3AawcxZRs0mMN2Pv1XsV0wtirtMnuteSiKNODOo5OLNFbBNvJSaalpP1_NIpY5r9j9O3BwpQ_b7lz62j0AYTf9uROjrRZvFsRyN6Fc3dRFcsu5FCqVxNQWTrbq3SUSWB2GADqUdJ2D6P90r4KT1xeJsc3B5w2fJAnanyQcgjDVlhWBQk-CmVcZlg4kAKtjuNjUtyloS0MwJD1bygZAo3IxpNAOzks_-&c=IeRlBuUB6Fhv5t_MaLYJXaaofiStBAeMFVoqGpSfzmsWeGKcuJx-fg==&ch=DnnSOAYNQov2-C3M3Gm55NEDaTnzKFG6nyiNFoh8XWBczfHeUpPt-g==)
---
One post-election breakdown confirmed that Black voters showed up in force during Saturday's contest. In a historic shift, Black voters constituted 34% of the primary electorate--soaring from a mere 25% in 2023--even though they represent just 31.8% of the state's registered voters.
When interviewed about Saturday's results, renowned Democratic political operative James Carville stated "we have a fighting chance" to win back Louisiana's US Senate seat and to put that race "on the watch list."
Adding weight to our win is the fact that voters faced unprecedented disinformation (while the GOP only canceled our House races, many were led to believe that all elections had been canceled) as well as extreme voter suppression from the GOP -- on election day our voter suppression hotline received 1000+ calls from voters.
While we came out on top this time, this is a wakeup call that we desperately need to make a sizable investment in poll watchers and in our precinct organizing program.
We have 5 months and 1 week until the General Election to build on this momentum. [We need to register new voters, hire precinct organizers and poll watchers, and scale our infrastructure. | | | Friend, it's Martin Sheen. You may know me from acting ‐‐ that's how I've made my living. **But activism is what I do to stay alive.**

I've stood in solidarity with farm workers and advocated for those fleeing poverty and violence. I've worked to protect our environment, and I've been arrested dozens of times for civil disobedience. Through all these experiences, I've learned that **you have to keep up the fight. You can't give up.**

And that couldn't be more true than it is today. We need to stand up to Donald Trump _every single day_ as he works to undermine the values that make America great. [**Will you show me you're in this fight now by signing this petition? >>**](http://go.dscc.org/go/23066?ask=7&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amounts=7%2C14%2C28%2C70&code=DPE-ND-20260520-MartinSheen-SheenStandUpToTrump-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20260520-MartinSheen-SheenStandUpToTrump-Pros-sl1&akid=23905%2E9716520%2EYsvUrw)

Martin Sheen

Defunding the police was one of the dumbest and most destructive ideas ever advanced by the left. In Seattle, city leaders are reconsidering this nonsense now that crime is surging. Homicides are way up, as well as car thefts and other serious crimes. Why have taxpayers put up with this for so long?
FOX News reports Seattle reverses course on defunding police as crime ravages locals: A huge crisis.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6729589&post_id=198603917&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk4NjAzOTE3LCJpYXQiOjE3NzkzMDQxMTUsImV4cCI6MTc4MTg5NjExNSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTY3Mjk1ODkiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.Bpv5c4yBPJBuEQi7d5dKGbTLIS89lSv3WSDyzgZ3Gz0)
Seattle residents Victoria Beach, Eli Hoshor, and Jonathan Choe said police shortages have left their city in dire straits in the aftermath of officials' anti-law enforcement rhetoric.
Homicides skyrocketed by 24% while motor vehicle thefts climbed by 30% in the city last year. Overall crime ticked up by 4%.
Mayor Bruce Harrell pushed for increased police presence to curb the issue, saying, "We need immediate action and innovation to respond to our public safety issues... Seattle saw a 4% rise in reported crime last year... We need more officers to address our staffing crisis."
Still, some residents' outlook is less than optimistic.
"Right now, I don't have a lot of hope," Beach told Todd Piro Wednesday on "Fox & Friends First."
"I think the mayor is on the right track, but Seattle is in a huge crisis. Our city has been destroyed, and we're not going to get it back anytime soon," she added.
Beach said she agrees that the city needs more police to help cut back on crime, saying the situation is currently a "free for all."
"If you want to commit a crime, move to Seattle," she said.
The mayor seems to be in over his head.

@MayorofSeattle taking political gamble by admitting he doesn't have "exact blueprint" in place to address concerns lingering in downtown. But some biz owners+neighbors victimized by crime are done waiting." -- Jonathan Choe Journalist (Seattle) (@choeshow) February 22, 2023.
The city can't even retain police officers.
EXCLUSIVE: Seattle Police Dept. lost 12 officers in January and hired eight. So far in February, they lost three additional officers.
"This puts total officers lost since the BLM riots and defund movement to roughly 525 -- a full third of the department. Unsurprisingly, crime is soaring."-- Jason Rantz on KTTH Radio (@jasonrantz) February 13, 2023.
Why would anyone want to be a police officer in a leftist city like Seattle where you'll be constantly demonized?
Senate Bill 5599, sponsored by far-left state senator Marko Liias (D-Everett) permits shelters or host homes to provide housing for runaway minors without being required to notify their parents. If a parent says no to removing their 14-year-old daughter's breasts, it is seen as neglect or abuse by many progressive activists and politicians. And that's precisely the kind of health care service that would be allowed without parental consent, according to the bill summary.
Sen. Joe Nguyen says he introduced an amendment that undoes language that allowed surgical intervention without parental consent. I've not yet seen the amendment, as it's not yet posted online. It does not change that minors can still receive gender-affirming care (such as hormone therapy) without parental consent. It also does not undo SB 5889 and SB 5313. He still maintains this is a bill about housing, but it is not: It is a bill about housing runaways seeking gender-affirming care.
The "Brandi Kruse" amendment, introduced today by a Democrat

@meetjoenguyen, clarifies that SB 5599 will NOT expand the type of healthcare kids can get without parental consent. I still don't like the bill, but this is a good improvement on the language. Thanks, Senator. -- Brandi Kruse (@BrandiKruse) February 14, 2023.

name: Josh Shapiro
subject: It’s official: The general election has begun.
body:
The primary is behind us. Now, we have to win the fight ahead.
[ ](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260520-1.QSHyNK&refcode=em-20260520-1&t=1&akid=1405%2E1086043%2EV8d1ST)
Peter, this is Josh Shapiro, and I wanted to make sure you heard the big news: **The general election for the must-win Governor’s race in Pennsylvania has begun.**
Our campaign is built on one simple idea: That public service should be about solving problems -- not chasing headlines or taking orders from Washington.
**That’s how I’ve led from Day One.**
When a section of I-95 collapsed in Philly, we didn’t waste time pointing fingers. We brought people together, got to work, and re-opened it in 12 days.
That’s the kind of leadership Pennsylvanians deserve: Leaders who show up, fix what’s broken, and keep moving forward.
**But now, Donald Trump and the far-right want to flip Pennsylvania and put that progress on the chopping block.**
Their plan is simple: Spend millions, flood the airwaves with attacks, and hope grassroots supporters like you don’t fight back in time.
Listen, I’ve never taken Pennsylvania for granted. Not for a day. Not for an hour. This is one of the most competitive states in the country, and if we let up now, the far-right will take full advantage.
**[So I’m humbly asking: Will you rush a $5 donation right now-- split between our campaign and Wes Moore -- to help us hit our first $25,000 fundraising goal of the general election?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260520-1.QSHyNK&refcode=em-20260520-1&t=2&akid=1405%2E1086043%2EV8d1ST)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260520-1.QSHyNK&amount=5&refcode=em-20260520-1&t=21&akid=1405%2E1086043%2EV8d1ST)**
Let’s get it done,
Josh Shapiro

name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: Demand accountability for Trump’s illegal war
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE
body:
|
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=5436%2E35263%2EpIy-xI)
Peter, Donald Trump’s war in Iran was neither inevitable nor necessary. In 2015, the United States had a deal in place to monitor Iran’s nuclear program with aggressive international inspections. It was working — _until Donald Trump ripped it up._ **Now, because of his reckless choices, Americans are paying the price for a war we never should have been dragged into.** Gas prices are rising. Farmers in Wisconsin are struggling with skyrocketing fertilizer and diesel costs. Families are feeling the squeeze at the grocery store and the gas pump. And while Republicans prepare to pour even more money into this war of choice, they’re cutting Medicaid, SNAP, and the healthcare tax credits that millions of Americans rely on. The American people do not support this war. They did not authorize this war. And they deserve answers. That’s why I’m continuing to push for Congress to assert its War Powers and finally hold this administration accountable. I’ve pushed for a vote several times — but Senate Republicans keep blocking the vote. We cannot give in. _**[Will you add your name today to support our War Powers petition and demand accountability for Trump’s illegal war?](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/signup/2605_warpowers?refcode=AU_STB_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20260520_PM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=5436%2E35263%2EpIy-xI)**_ | [ ADD YOUR NAME ](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/signup/2605_warpowers?refcode=AU_STB_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20260520_PM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=5436%2E35263%2EpIy-xI)
---
Republicans don’t want to admit the facts, but the effects of this war are clear.
All of us are less safe with this war ongoing, with hardliners emboldened in Iran, and their nuclear program intact.
Congress has a constitutional responsibility here. We cannot sit by while this administration drags our country deeper into a war of choice without answers, accountability, or authorization.
_**[If you agree, add your name today. Tell Republicans in Congress: assert your War Powers, hold hearings, and put an end to this illegal war.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/signup/2605_warpowers?refcode=AU_STB_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20260520_PM1_V1_S1&t=6&akid=5436%2E35263%2EpIy-xI)**_

| Dear Patriot,
---
I fell into a coma. I was put on a ventilator. I was given my last rites.
---
But by the grace of God and the power of _YOUR_ prayers...
---
**_...I’M BACK!_**
---
I’m a _fighter_ to my core – and now I’m 100% recovered and ready to win the FINAL BATTLE for my freedom against a vengeful Democrat Attorney General who wants to **IMPRISON** me for _20 YEARS_!
---
**A coma couldn’t take me down. Neither will this bloodthirsty left-wing prosecutor!**
---
During my coma, I had a deeply spiritual experience.
---
Humbly, I cannot say I was headed straight for heaven. Rather, it felt like I was headed to a trial by St. Peter where all my life’s deeds were put on display.
---
That moment put everything in perspective.
---
**No matter what happens in my RIGGED TRIAL in Arizona, the ONLY trial that ultimately matters is the one before God.**
---
**_And I can say with absolute confidence that when I was tested, I chose to stand by my principles – even if it meant getting _ARRESTED_ ... TWICE!_**
---
So, just as I’ve fought the Mafia, the Deep State, countless witch hunts, and now _even a coma_ , I will fight this rigged case against me – and WIN!
---
**_But to win, I’m going to need the best defense I can get. Just as I heavily relied on your prayers, I’m honestly going to need your support to secure a top-notch defense to beat a left-wing prosecutor hell-bent on throwing me in prison._**
---

clean_body: From Navy helicopter pilot to Congress | Fellow American, I know your inbox is probably overflowing right now with politicians begging for your hard-earned money using every scare tactic in the book. I truly hate having to send messages like this, but I really appreciate your time! My last message didn't get the response I was hoping for, and now I'm starting to feel like we're falling behind. We can't keep fighting if we don't have the resources to keep the lights on and pay my amazing staff. Let me take a second to re-introduce myself: My name is Jen Kiggans. I am a former Navy helicopter pilot. I flew H-46s and H-3s in the Persian Gulf. After my time in the military, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a board-certified Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. I am married to a retired Navy F/A-18 pilot, and now I am a proud Navy Mom. And that is exactly WHY I ran for Congress in 2022. I knew that I needed to step up and do my part to make sure that my four kids inherit a GREAT America! Against all odds, we flipped Virginia's 2nd District RED in one of the tightest, must-win races in the entire country. But elections have serious consequences and these radical Left Democrats are not going to give up without a fight. Now, National Democrats and Left-leaning Super PACs are raking in millions to attack me and take back the House this year. They want to turn our great commonwealth into California AND my far-Left opponent JUST announced she raised over $1.75 MILLION in the first quarter alone. They will stop at absolutely nothing to win. So today, I'm recruiting YOU to join my mission to save our country from the Democrats' grasp once and for all. That is why I am about to ask you what I know is no small favor. | | As a Navy Vet, I've never turned away from a tough fight, and trust me, I won't start now. But to keep our House Majority intact and continue fighting for our country's future, I really need your support! Thank you all so very, very much! \- Jen Kiggans | Paid for by Kiggans for Congress Use of military images or rank does not imply endorsement by the U.S. Department of War or the Navy P.O. | | |
---
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/9015?t=1&akid=9754%2E400544%2Ef2VB3Y)
Friend, it’s Governor Josh Shapiro.

I’m a dad, a husband, the son of a pediatrician and a teacher. **Now, I’m the official Democratic nominee in my reelection campaign for the Governor of Pennsylvania.**

Growing up, my parents taught me about the responsibility to help others and repair the world around us.
Those lessons have guided me my whole life — as a State Rep, County Commissioner, as Attorney General, and now as Governor.

When I-95 collapsed in Pennsylvania, we rebuilt it in 12 days. When families needed relief, we cut taxes. When kids needed a fair shot, we invested in public schools and delivered free breakfast.

And when Donald Trump and the far-right threatened our freedoms, I stood up and fought back.
**Now, I’m running for reelection because all of that progress is on the line.
**
But friend, Pennsylvania is one of the toughest battleground states in the country. Trump won here in 2024, and National Republicans think they can win here again. I know we can stop them, but I’ll need every bit of support I can muster.

Patriot,

It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. **But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250****th**** birthday.**

What a night.

Across the country, progressive candidates running on bold, uncompromising platforms pulled off major victories against the Democratic establishment.

In Pennsylvania, Chris Rabb and Bob Brooks won their primaries — with Chris defeating two corporate-backed opponents. In Kentucky, Charles Booker won his Senate race. All three were endorsed by the Working Families Party. All three refused to back down from their values. All three won.

**Here's what last night showed us: candidates with moral clarity and a real agenda for working families aren't just the right choice — _they're the winning choice._ Voters are done with half-measures and establishment politics. They want fighters.**

That's exactly what Mai Vang is running on in CA-07.

Mai is running on Medicare for All, affordable housing, and a commitment to never taking a dime from corporate PACs, AIPAC, or weapons manufacturers — because Sacramento families deserve a Congress member who actually fights for them.

**FIRST:** The Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade in 2022 – undoing 50 years of legal precedent and ripping away women’s federal abortion rights.
**THEN:** Republicans started rolling back abortion access in the states and coming after mifepristone, a medication abortion that study after study has shown to be safe and effective.

name: Daniel Cameron
subject: Thank you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Cameron for Senate, Inc
body:
Yesterday’s election didn’t turn out exactly as we had hoped

| | | | |
---
|
---
| | Friend,
Yesterday’s election didn’t turn out exactly as we had hoped, but standing on that stage last night, looking out at friends, family and brothers and sisters in Christ, I was reminded just how lucky, fortunate, and blessed Makenze and I are.
A good friend of mine once told me that life is not linear. There are ups and downs, peaks and valleys, but you keep going. You keep working. You keep moving forward. That is exactly what Makenze and I will continue to do. We will keep raising our boys, keep serving the Lord, and keep putting one foot in front of the other.
This journey for our family is not over. We have the great privilege of raising three wonderful boys – Theodore, Bennett, and Harrison. Our mission field now is our home. We entered this race for our kids, your kids, and your grandkids – so they could grow up in a country that lives up to the ideals of its founding, a country based on merit and opportunity.
It has been an honor to run in this race, an honor to serve in public office, and an honor to be the beneficiary of your prayers, your encouragement, and your incredibly generous support.
God bless you for making this campaign possible. We ran it the best we knew how, and while we came up short, I hope I made you proud.
Thank you,
Daniel Cameron

clean_body: Yesterday’s election didn’t turn out exactly as we had hoped | | | | | | | | Friend, Yesterday’s election didn’t turn out exactly as we had hoped, but standing on that stage last night, looking out at friends, family and brothers and sisters in Christ, I was reminded just how lucky, fortunate, and blessed Makenze and I are. A good friend of mine once told me that life is not linear. There are ups and downs, peaks and valleys, but you keep going. You keep working. You keep moving forward. That is exactly what Makenze and I will continue to do. We will keep raising our boys, keep serving the Lord, and keep putting one foot in front of the other. This journey for our family is not over. We have the great privilege of raising three wonderful boys – Theodore, Bennett, and Harrison. Our mission field now is our home. We entered this race for our kids, your kids, and your grandkids – so they could grow up in a country that lives up to the ideals of its founding, a country based on merit and opportunity. It has been an honor to run in this race, an honor to serve in public office, and an honor to be the beneficiary of your prayers, your encouragement, and your incredibly generous support. God bless you for making this campaign possible. We ran it the best we knew how, and while we came up short, I hope I made you proud. Thank you, Daniel Cameron | | | | | | ~ | | ~ ---|---|--- | | Paid for by Cameron for Senate, Inc. | | | You received this email because you subscribed to our list. No one understands that better than me.
| **__A Letter from the Desk of Rep. Elise Stefanik__**
---
Peter,
---
President Trump has made it clear that he’ll do whatever it takes to WIN the midterms because he knows how vital our House Majority is to passing the America First agenda: _**“We must keep the Majority _at_ _all_ _costs_.”**_
---
No one understands that better than me.
---
Last year, I did what our country needed and withdrew my nomination to serve in President Trump’s cabinet to remain in the House and _protect_ our razor-thin Majority.
---
_And thank God I did. My vote was ultimately the tie-breaking vote to pass the President’s Big Beautiful Bill and grant tax cuts to millions of American families!_
---
For me, America First was never just a campaign slogan.
---
For every remaining minute that I have the honor to serve you in Congress, doing what’s right for our country will _**always**_ be my top priority.
---
**That’s why, even though I’m no longer running for reelection, I’m still committed to doing everything I can to help the President DEFEND his Majority.**
---
_Since I no longer need funds for my own campaign, I’ve decided the most effective way I can help is to use my grassroots donor network –**among the most powerful in the entire country** – to help America First Republicans WIN the key battleground races of the midterms. _
---
_After all the sacrifices I’ve made for our House Majority, you can rest assured that I’m going to spend every second I have left in Congress fighting to stop the Democrats from seizing control and DESTROYING everything we’ve fought so hard to accomplish._
---
But as we approach yet another critical fundraising deadline, I have no choice but to ask dedicated America First patriots like YOU to join me.
---

clean_body: No one understands that better than me. | A Letter from the Desk of Rep. Elise Stefanik Peter, President Trump has made it clear that he’ll do whatever it takes to WIN the midterms because he knows how vital our House Majority is to passing the America First agenda: “We must keep the Majority at all costs.” No one understands that better than me. Last year, I did what our country needed and withdrew my nomination to serve in President Trump’s cabinet to remain in the House and protect our razor-thin Majority. And thank God I did. My vote was ultimately the tie-breaking vote to pass the President’s Big Beautiful Bill and grant tax cuts to millions of American families! For me, America First was never just a campaign slogan. For every remaining minute that I have the honor to serve you in Congress, doing what’s right for our country will always be my top priority. That’s why, even though I’m no longer running for reelection, I’m still committed to doing everything I can to help the President DEFEND his Majority. Since I no longer need funds for my own campaign, I’ve decided the most effective way I can help is to use my grassroots donor network –among the most powerful in the entire country – to help America First Republicans WIN the key battleground races of the midterms. After all the sacrifices I’ve made for our House Majority, you can rest assured that I’m going to spend every second I have left in Congress fighting to stop the Democrats from seizing control and DESTROYING everything we’ve fought so hard to accomplish. But as we approach yet another critical fundraising deadline, I have no choice but to ask dedicated America First patriots like YOU to join me. Thank you and God Bless, Rep. name: Jon Ossoff
subject: I’m officially the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Georgia
body:
---
| [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-ossoff-split?amount=20&refcode=em_20260520_7221_fr&refcode2=7221_22930333_Dmw84C&akid=7221%2E22930333%2EDmw84C)
---
_Thank you, Georgia!_
After last night’s primary, I am officially the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Georgia.
This race in Georgia is likely to be the most competitive and expensive U.S. Senate race in 2026. I am the *only* endangered Democratic incumbent U.S. Senator in the midterms. Republicans are preparing to unleash massive resources attacking me and this seat.
But our victory will be powered once again by overwhelming grassroots support.
If you know the stakes and how important your support is — and if you are ready to split a donation to help start the general election in the strongest position possible and support the DNC please use this link:
[**<https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-ossoff-split/General-Election>**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-ossoff-split?amount=20&refcode=em_20260520_7221_fr&refcode2=7221_22930333_Dmw84C&akid=7221%2E22930333%2EDmw84C)
Otherwise, let me tell you a bit about why I ran for Senate — and why this moment is just as urgent.
Before I was elected, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. We exposed wrongdoing in countries where criticizing the government is dangerous, where whistleblowers and witnesses will only meet in secret, where protest carries the risk of prosecution.
More and more, the atmosphere under Trump has reminded me of those places — places where dissent was silenced by intimidation and where unaccountable elites plunder and trade power for profit with impunity.
I ran for Senate because I saw that Trump’s election endangered our Republic and I was determined to confront him and the corruption that made his rise possible.
_And that work isn’t over yet._
**This is not a drill and it’s not a bad dream. As citizens, it’s the test of our lifetimes.**
So please, I’m humbly asking: [**Split a contribution between my reelection campaign and the DNC. Do it today and help us start the general election in the strongest possible position.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-ossoff-split?amount=20&refcode=em_20260520_7221_fr&refcode2=7221_22930333_Dmw84C&akid=7221%2E22930333%2EDmw84C)

We know MAGA’s election playbook: _Lie. Enrage. Distract_.
And between the Fulton County raid, the executive order attacking voting, and the plotting of the MAGA loyalists on our state election board... they've made their plans very clear.
But we’ve beaten them before — _right here in Georgia_.
In 2021, we defeated an entrenched GOP incumbent by staying on offense and organizing a turnout effort totally unprecedented in its scale and intensity.
**This is the next test.**
And the best insurance against MAGA’s dirty tricks is _landslide margins of victory_.
My team is preparing a larger-than-ever-before effort to get out the vote and defend voting rights.
That work is not easy or cheap. We have to work relentlessly through Election Day, and we need the resources to reach every single voter.
[**So, I have to ask: Can you please make a donation to my reelection campaign and the DNC?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-ossoff-split?amount=20&refcode=em_20260520_7221_fr&refcode2=7221_22930333_Dmw84C&akid=7221%2E22930333%2EDmw84C)

— Jon

Team,
Exciting news! **I 'm officially the Democratic nominee for Congress in PA-09.**
I'm honored, I'm grateful, and I'm ready to keep pushing.
The incredible turnout yesterday sent a message loud and clear: our part of Pennsylvania is ready for change.
In a district where Democrats have been counted out for years, we're showing what's possible when we roll up our sleeves and get to work. And this is just the beginning.
[DONATE NOW](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/292502c2-06d4-4785-a49f-34cc0957bed8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Our congressman climbed up the ladder and pulled it up behind him. Dan Meuser doubled his net worth in office while voting to kick 30,000 people here off their health care and raise the cost of living even higher. He's done a whole lot for himself and worse than nothing for us.
We're sick of it. We deserve better, and we're ready for better.
**But winning in November is going to take all of us. Meuser has his own millions and his Mar-a-Lago mega-donors. But we have people.**
People are knocking doors, having conversations with their neighbors, and pitching in whatever they can because they believe in what we're building. That's how we've gotten this far, and that's how we're going to win.
**[So today, as the official Democratic nominee, I'm asking: will you chip in to help us start the next phase of this race off strong?](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/292502c2-06d4-4785-a49f-34cc0957bed8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

body:
Nearly 500 Democrats move to censure Polis. His own party meets Wednesday to decide what to do.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends!
**🎙️ Don't miss the latest episode of Unleashed with Heidi Ganahl!** Heidi sits down with Nick — the Colorado Springs veteran behind Big Timber Lodge and Big Timber Armory — who turned his YouTube channel into a gun rights organizing machine and spent over a year pushing the Trump DOJ to sue Colorado over its firearms laws. _[Spoiler: it worked.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_
Want your full news breakdown? Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Here's a summary of today's top stories:
**🏔️ Here in Colorado...** The Colorado Supreme Court (5-2) ordered Children's Hospital Colorado to [resume transgender treatments for minor plaintiffs](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Nearly [500 Democrats filed a censure complaint against Gov. Polis](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for commuting Tina Peters' sentence — but stayed silent when Polis also [commuted a man convicted of shooting a Douglas County deputy](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). The [Trump DOJ sued Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) over its semiautomatic weapons ban and magazine limit. And Colorado ranks [top three nationally for scams](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) targeting residents 60 and older.
**🏠 Local Stories...** A JeffCo safety audit flagging 150+ imminent threats weeks before the 2025 Evergreen High School shooting was [initially withheld from a parent's open records request](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Rural Coloado residents are paying $4.34/gallon — 50% more than when Trump took office — while [remaining supportive of his administration](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). A Colorado Appeals Court [upheld Boulder's homeless camping bans](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), and Republican Naomi Riess is challenging Democrat Katie Stewart in [House District 59](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on drug enforcement and bond reform.
**✍️ Commentary Spotlight...** Colorado's legislature closed its 2026 session with a $46.8 billion budget — [62% larger than when Polis took office](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) — with critics citing fees and TABOR workarounds over deficit relief. The Colorado Accountability Project highlights Kentucky's new law restricting lame-duck governor authority as [a model for Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). And Colleen Enos [urges support for ballot initiatives 108, 109, and 110 this fall](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), covering girls' sports, sex trafficking protections, and irreversible procedures on minors.
This is your Mountain Minute for Wednesday, May 20, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Nearly 500 Democrats move to censure Polis. His own party meets Wednesday to decide what to do.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
The Colorado Democratic Party’s central committee meets Wednesday to decide what to do about its own governor.
In front of it is a formal complaint, signed by hundreds of Democrats and growing by the hour, asking the party to censure Gov. Jared Polis for commuting Tina Peters’ sentence. The signers are not asking a court to undo the commutation. They are not asking the legislature to reverse it. They cannot.
Colorado’s constitution gives the governor sole clemency authority, and neither the courts nor the legislature nor the party can take back what Polis already signed. What the signers want is for the party to declare that one of its own governors acted against its interests, to bar him from its marquee events and to say publicly that his decision does not speak for the party.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

Colorado only turns 150 once._ __Secure your tickets now and be part of it.
[GET YOUR TICKETS NOW!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Polis explained both commutations in writing. One drew a party revolt.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Two commutations, one day:** On the same day Gov. Polis commuted Tina Peters' sentence, he also commuted the sentence of Brandin Kreuzer — convicted of first-degree assault on a Douglas County sheriff's deputy during a 2008 crime spree — reducing his 50-year sentence and granting parole effective June 1.
* **One drew a party revolt, the other drew silence:** The Peters commutation triggered hundreds of Democratic signatures, an impeachment call, and a senator's rebuke; the Kreuzer commutation drew no party response — only condemnation from the Douglas County Sheriff's Office, the wounded deputy, and the prosecuting DA, who said the commutation was "based on a couple of lies."
* **A disputed claim in the clemency letter:** The Kreuzer clemency letter claimed his codefendant received a 7-year youth-offender sentence; contemporaneous reporting shows that codefendant was sentenced to 45 years — a discrepancy the Polis administration has not publicly addressed.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|

**[Southwest Colorado’s voice has gone unheard in Denver. Naomi Riess is running to change it.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **A fentanyl crisis that hits close to home:** Naomi Riess filed as a Republican for Colorado House District 59 after her daughter-in-law — a sheriff's employee — was hospitalized following a fentanyl exposure on the job, and the suspect was released on a personal recognizance bond that local DAs say they're powerless to challenge under state law.
* **35 years of Southwest Colorado roots:** A former Democrat turned Republican, Riess built a land use consulting business with a 99% approval rate, served 15 years on the La Plata County Historic Preservation Commission, and is running on a "healthy communities" platform of safe streets, attainable housing, and schools that keep kids in Southwest Colorado.
* **A three-point race in November:** Riess faces Democrat incumbent Katie Stewart head-to-head in a district Stewart won by just three points in 2024 — with unaffiliated voters outnumbering both parties combined in La Plata County, making them the deciding factor in what could be a flippable seat.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[‘If this bill passes, we’re moving’: How a Colorado veteran became a political voice online](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY RMV STAFF | STATE | MAY 19** _A Colorado Springs defense worker who never wanted to be in politics now says the only place left to win back gun rights in this state is a federal courtroom — and that the window is open right now._
__
**[The parent-child bond is not the government’s to break](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY COLLEEN ENOS | COMMENTARY | MAY 19** _Each morning you kiss your 12-year-old daughter goodbye while sending her off to school. You trust that her teachers care about her and are nurturing her mind, not hiding things from you. Weeks later, you discover your once-bright child is now anxious, isolated, and medically altered, because her trusted teachers have secretly counselled her to take life-altering hormones while keeping you in the dark—the mother who loved her, sacrificed for her and would lay down your life to protect her._
__

**[Three minutes at the microphone: What Colorado’s 2026 session really looked like](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY RMV EDITORIAL BOARD | COMMENTARY | MAY 18** _From housing fights and election battles to late-night hearings and grassroots backlash, the 2026 session left many Coloradans questioning where decisions are really made._

The primary is behind us. Now, we have to win the fight ahead.
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/109761?t=6&akid=24472%2E878179%2Et9uVDH) It’s Governor Josh Shapiro.

I’m a dad, a husband, the son of a pediatrician and a teacher. **Now, I’m the official Democratic nominee in my reelection campaign for the Governor of Pennsylvania.**

Growing up, my parents taught me about the responsibility to help others and repair the world around us.

Those lessons have guided me my whole life — as a State Rep, County Commissioner, as Attorney General, and now as Governor.

When I-95 collapsed in Pennsylvania, we rebuilt it in 12 days. When families needed relief, we cut taxes. When kids needed a fair shot, we invested in public schools and delivered free breakfast.

And when Donald Trump and the far-right threatened our freedoms, I stood up and fought back.

**Now, I’m running for reelection because all of that progress is on the line.**

But friend, Pennsylvania is one of the toughest battleground states in the country. Trump won here in 2024, and National Republicans think they can win here again. I know we can stop them, but I’ll need every bit of support I can muster.

# You won’t believe who just endorsed our campaign
---
| Dear Friend, Our work in Congress is about delivering results for our community. The momentum behind our campaign is growing because people are seeing what effective leadership can accomplish. The Ridgecrest Daily Independent’s endorsement highlighted our efforts supporting our military, defending our local energy producers, and enhancing responsible forest management to prevent wildfires declaring me the “best choice for 20th Congressional District."

And recently, even our skeptics are realizing our effectiveness with the Fresno Bee Editorial Board endorsing our campaign, declaring that the “Central Valley needs a strong leader” and recognizing me as the right choice to represent California’s 20th Congressional District. We are delivering real results:
* Building Water Infrastructure — I helped secure $540 million for the infrastructure and water resources our farmers, families, and communities depend on.
* Improving Our Highways — Bringing home critical funding for the Centennial Corridor and long-overdue Highway 99 safety improvements.
* Protecting Our Communities — Passing Dalilah’s Law to keep dangerous drivers off our roads and strengthen public safety.
* Saving Rural Healthcare — Delivering millions to reopen our local maternity wards and emergency services in outlying communities.

Effective leadership is about making sure our community has a seat at the table on important decisions in Washington D.C., and deliver for the people back home. But I do not work for newspaper editorial boards. I work for you. And while these endorsements are energizing our campaign, they are also intensifying the attacks from the opposition. They see the momentum. That is why I need your help today. Will you stand with us and help keep our “Delivering Results” message on the airwaves with a contribution of $25, $50, or $100 today? Let’s keep fighting.
Let’s keep delivering.
And let’s win this for the Central Valley and the 20th District. Sincerely, Vince Fong

##### **MAY 20, 2026 | THE WAR ROOM | DISPATCH #6**
## **My fellow patriots of District 11, my fellow Floridians, my fellow Americans --**
Managerial surrender killed 5,622 Floridians. The Strike-Secure method saved thousands. This is not a policy dispute. This is a constitutional crisis--and the evidence is measurable, the cost is human, and the strike is structural. A border crisis the Biden Administration deliberately created has turned our communities into corridors for synthetic poison. The duty to protect life has been treated as optional. The border has been treated as discretionary.
* * *
## **The Conflict: A Constitutional Crisis, Not a Policy Dispute**
The federal government has abandoned its constitutional duty to provide for the common defense. Under the Biden Administration, the Department of Homeland Security issued directives that unilaterally disarmed the border--deprioritizing enforcement, terminating the Migrant Protection Protocols, and creating mass parole programs through agency discretion rather than congressional vote. The result: 5,622 Floridians died of fentanyl in 2022.
The Constitution vests legislative power in Congress. When bureaucrats make law through directive, they violate the constitutional structure that James Madison designed. As Madison wrote in Federalist No. 57, the aim of the constitution is to obtain rulers who pursue the common good--and to take "the most effectual precautions for keeping them virtuous whilst they continue to hold their public trust." When a bureaucrat can open the border without your representative's vote, those precautions have been abandoned. The REINS Act restores them by forcing Congress to vote on the rules that govern your life--and making your representative own that vote.
#### **Familial Security**
The fentanyl invasion is an assault on the Primary Pillar of Familial Security. When the border is unsecured, when poison flows freely, the family cannot withstand, cannot build, cannot secure its future. Fentanyl does not discriminate. It kills 18-year-olds. It kills parents. It kills grandparents. It destroys the family unit at its foundation--the ability to protect those you love from preventable harm.
#### **Political Security**
And the bureaucratic unaccountability that enabled the fentanyl invasion is an assault on the Secondary Pillar of Political Security. The administrative state has shed the effectual precautions Madison designed. Unelected bureaucrats never have to face the people they govern. They issue directives from behind the veil of bureaucracy, answerable to no constituency, facing no voter, accounting for no consequences. When a bureaucrat can open the gates of our national home without your representative's vote, they have violated the Founders' design. They have broken the control mechanism that makes constitutional government work.
* * *
## **The Impact: 5,622 Floridians Paid the Price**
Mari Rodriguez lost her 18-year-old daughter Iman to fentanyl poisoning in South Florida. One pill. One night. A family shattered by a poison that should never have reached our streets.
Congressional District 11 has not been exempt from this invasion. In Bushnell, deputies recently arrested a convicted felon armed with a handgun and an AR-15, caught with trafficking amounts of fentanyl at the Rodeway Inn. The threat is already inside our gates--and the REINS Act is the tool to close them. When bureaucrats can open the border without your vote, the poison reaches every city, town, and rural community in District 11. When your representative must vote on the record, the border stays closed and the poison stays out.
The erosion of Familial Security is measured in graves. The erosion of Political Security is measured in directives issued without your vote. Both are consequences of a system that treats the common defence as an option rather than a mandate.
But Florida refused to accept that death toll as inevitable. Under Governor DeSantis, the S.A.F.E. program has fought back--and the results are measurable: a 46% drop in fentanyl deaths. Six hundred (600) pounds of poison that will never reach the streets of District 11 and 65,000 pills that will never reach a child. Nearly 3,000 traffickers who will never deal again, and 970 firearms seized from convicted felons and drug cartels. Thousands more people alive today to build, to love, and to change the world, because one state refused to surrender. This is the Strike-Secure method in action at the state level: strike at the root of the threat, secure the corresponding blessing directly to the American Kitchen Table.
**Vote. Fuel. Fight.** 5,622 Floridians died because bureaucrats faced no accountability. Vote Ivette Palomo and The American Kitchen Table on **[The Reckoning Date-- August 18, 2026](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b9a8c4d1-c7c9-429b-bd84-2629b957999d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). **Fuel the Strike with**[Your Contribution.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/fafd5b28-6af8-4d92-8cee-f894f793e7c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Fight To Win!**
* * *
## **The Strategy: Strike the Root, Secure the Table**
The establishment offers bureaucratic solutions--more agencies, more directives, more discretion--for the very system that failed 5,622 Floridians and their families. We offer the constitutional recalibration Madison designed.
Florida proved the Strike-Secure method works at the state level. But the root of the crisis is federal. The directives that opened the border came from Washington. The strike must reach Washington.
**Strike the Root:** The primary tool is the REINS Act. It strips unelected bureaucrats of the power to create major rules without an up-or-down vote from Congress. If a bureaucrat wants to open the gates, they must face the people's representatives. Had the REINS Act been law, the Biden Administration could not have unilaterally disarmed the border through agency discretion--the directives that opened the gates would have required a congressional vote. This ensures Political Security by restoring citizen control over government.
Some will ask: "Would Congress have voted against those directives?" The answer reverts to you--to permanent vigilance, to each voter's action at the ballot box. The REINS Act does not guarantee that bad directives won't happen. It guarantees that if they do, your representative will have to own the vote. Right now, bureaucrats open the border and face no consequences. Under the REINS Act, your representative would have to look you in the eye and explain their vote. That is the effectual precaution Madison designed. That is the control mechanism that makes constitutional government work.
We have seen this method work. When the Trump Administration restored enforcement, the results were measurable: twelve consecutive months of zero releases at the border, southwest border apprehensions down 94% from the Biden administration, and drug seizures up 60%--including 463 pounds of fentanyl seized in April 2026 alone. The common defense was treated as a mandate rather than a discretion. This was the Strike-Secure method in action at the federal level: strike at the root by restoring enforcement, secure the corresponding blessing of safety directly to the American Kitchen Table.
**Secure the Table:** Florida's S.A.F.E. program has demonstrated that state-level action produces measurable results. We support and expand this model to safeguard Familial Security by retaking operational control of the border and protecting the American family from the invasion of synthetic poison.
The choice is clear. Managerial surrender or structural strike.
**Vote. Fuel. Fight.** The REINS Act forces bureaucrats to face the people's representatives--and the S.A.F.E. program proves that state-level action saves lives. Vote Ivette Palomo and The American Kitchen Table on **[The Reckoning Date-- August 18, 2026](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b9a8c4d1-c7c9-429b-bd84-2629b957999d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). **Fuel the Strike with**[Your Contribution.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/fafd5b28-6af8-4d92-8cee-f894f793e7c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Fight To Win!**
* * *
## **Your Battle Plan: Three Steps to Strike Back**
Join me in this endeavor--
**Step 1: Gather Your Evidence.** Document the failures. When you see fentanyl in your community, when you see the consequences of an open border, when you see bureaucrats operating without accountability--record it. Screenshot the directives. Save the local reports. Gather the proof that the administrative state has abandoned its duty to protect.
**Step 2: Personalize the Cost.** The numbers are staggering--but numbers alone do not move people. Stories do. Tell me how this crisis has touched your family, your neighborhood, your community. Personalize the cost of bureaucratic failure. Make it real. Make it human.
**Step 3: Send Me the Proof.** Forward your evidence to evidence@americankitchentable.com. Every piece of evidence strengthens the case. Every story adds weight to the strike. Every voice that joins makes the structural case for the REINS Act and the constitutional recalibration Madison designed. Send me the proof, and I will carry it to the floor of Congress as evidence for the REINS Act. Every story, every statistic, every shattered family becomes a weapon in the fight to restore constitutional accountability.
* * *
## **Forward, Always**
The establishment treats border enforcement as discretionary. I will treat it as a constitutional mandate.
The establishment allows bureaucrats to open the gates without your vote. I will force them to face the people's representatives.
The establishment accepts 5,622 deaths as inevitable. I refuse to surrender.
**Vote. Fuel. Fight.** The common defence is not discretionary--it is a constitutional mandate. Vote Ivette Palomo and The American Kitchen Table on **[The Reckoning Date-- August 18, 2026](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b9a8c4d1-c7c9-429b-bd84-2629b957999d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). **Fuel the Strike with**[Your Contribution.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/fafd5b28-6af8-4d92-8cee-f894f793e7c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Fight To Win!**
Strike the root. Secure the table.
Forward, always--
Ivette

Florida proved the alternative works. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more The Constitutional Recalibration to Restore Madison's Design: 5,622 Floridians died because bureaucrats faced no accountability. Florida proved the alternative works. | | | May 20 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- MAY 20, 2026 | THE WAR ROOM | DISPATCH #6 My fellow patriots of District 11, my fellow Floridians, my fellow Americans -- Managerial surrender killed 5,622 Floridians. The Strike-Secure method saved thousands. This is not a policy dispute. This is a constitutional crisis--and the evidence is measurable, the cost is human, and the strike is structural. A border crisis the Biden Administration deliberately created has turned our communities into corridors for synthetic poison. The duty to protect life has been treated as optional. The border has been treated as discretionary. The Conflict: A Constitutional Crisis, Not a Policy Dispute The federal government has abandoned its constitutional duty to provide for the common defense. Under the Biden Administration, the Department of Homeland Security issued directives that unilaterally disarmed the border--deprioritizing enforcement, terminating the Migrant Protection Protocols, and creating mass parole programs through agency discretion rather than congressional vote. The result: 5,622 Floridians died of fentanyl in 2022. The Constitution vests legislative power in Congress. When bureaucrats make law through directive, they violate the constitutional structure that James Madison designed. As Madison wrote in Federalist No. 57, the aim of the constitution is to obtain rulers who pursue the common good--and to take "the most effectual precautions for keeping them virtuous whilst they continue to hold their public trust." When a bureaucrat can open the border without your representative's vote, those precautions have been abandoned. The REINS Act restores them by forcing Congress to vote on the rules that govern your life--and making your representative own that vote. Familial Security The fentanyl invasion is an assault on the Primary Pillar of Familial Security. When the border is unsecured, when poison flows freely, the family cannot withstand, cannot build, cannot secure its future. Fentanyl does not discriminate. It kills 18-year-olds. It kills parents. It kills grandparents. It destroys the family unit at its foundation--the ability to protect those you love from preventable harm. Political Security And the bureaucratic unaccountability that enabled the fentanyl invasion is an assault on the Secondary Pillar of Political Security. The administrative state has shed the effectual precautions Madison designed. Unelected bureaucrats never have to face the people they govern. They issue directives from behind the veil of bureaucracy, answerable to no constituency, facing no voter, accounting for no consequences. When a bureaucrat can open the gates of our national home without your representative's vote, they have violated the Founders' design. They have broken the control mechanism that makes constitutional government work. The Impact: 5,622 Floridians Paid the Price Mari Rodriguez lost her 18-year-old daughter Iman to fentanyl poisoning in South Florida. One pill. One night. A family shattered by a poison that should never have reached our streets. Congressional District 11 has not been exempt from this invasion. In Bushnell, deputies recently arrested a convicted felon armed with a handgun and an AR-15, caught with trafficking amounts of fentanyl at the Rodeway Inn. The threat is already inside our gates--and the REINS Act is the tool to close them. When bureaucrats can open the border without your vote, the poison reaches every city, town, and rural community in District 11. When your representative must vote on the record, the border stays closed and the poison stays out. The erosion of Familial Security is measured in graves. The erosion of Political Security is measured in directives issued without your vote. Both are consequences of a system that treats the common defence as an option rather than a mandate. But Florida refused to accept that death toll as inevitable. Under Governor DeSantis, the S.A.F.E. program has fought back--and the results are measurable: a 46% drop in fentanyl deaths. Six hundred (600) pounds of poison that will never reach the streets of District 11 and 65,000 pills that will never reach a child. Nearly 3,000 traffickers who will never deal again, and 970 firearms seized from convicted felons and drug cartels. Thousands more people alive today to build, to love, and to change the world, because one state refused to surrender. This is the Strike-Secure method in action at the state level: strike at the root of the threat, secure the corresponding blessing directly to the American Kitchen Table. Vote. Fuel. Fight. 5,622 Floridians died because bureaucrats faced no accountability. Vote Ivette Palomo and The American Kitchen Table on . Fuel the Strike with Fight To Win! The Strategy: Strike the Root, Secure the Table The establishment offers bureaucratic solutions--more agencies, more directives, more discretion--for the very system that failed 5,622 Floridians and their families. We offer the constitutional recalibration Madison designed. Florida proved the Strike-Secure method works at the state level. But the root of the crisis is federal. The directives that opened the border came from Washington. The strike must reach Washington. Strike the Root: The primary tool is the REINS Act. It strips unelected bureaucrats of the power to create major rules without an up-or-down vote from Congress. If a bureaucrat wants to open the gates, they must face the people's representatives. Had the REINS Act been law, the Biden Administration could not have unilaterally disarmed the border through agency discretion--the directives that opened the gates would have required a congressional vote. This ensures Political Security by restoring citizen control over government. Some will ask: "Would Congress have voted against those directives?" The answer reverts to you--to permanent vigilance, to each voter's action at the ballot box. The REINS Act does not guarantee that bad directives won't happen. It guarantees that if they do, your representative will have to own the vote. Right now, bureaucrats open the border and face no consequences. Under the REINS Act, your representative would have to look you in the eye and explain their vote. That is the effectual precaution Madison designed. That is the control mechanism that makes constitutional government work. We have seen this method work. When the Trump Administration restored enforcement, the results were measurable: twelve consecutive months of zero releases at the border, southwest border apprehensions down 94% from the Biden administration, and drug seizures up 60%--including 463 pounds of fentanyl seized in April 2026 alone. The common defense was treated as a mandate rather than a discretion. This was the Strike-Secure method in action at the federal level: strike at the root by restoring enforcement, secure the corresponding blessing of safety directly to the American Kitchen Table. Secure the Table: Florida's S.A.F.E. program has demonstrated that state-level action produces measurable results. We support and expand this model to safeguard Familial Security by retaking operational control of the border and protecting the American family from the invasion of synthetic poison. The choice is clear. Managerial surrender or structural strike. Vote. Fuel. Fight. The REINS Act forces bureaucrats to face the people's representatives--and the S.A.F.E. program proves that state-level action saves lives. Vote Ivette Palomo and The American Kitchen Table on . Fuel the Strike with Fight To Win! Your Battle Plan: Three Steps to Strike Back Join me in this endeavor-- Step 1: Gather Your Evidence. Document the failures. When you see fentanyl in your community, when you see the consequences of an open border, when you see bureaucrats operating without accountability--record it. Screenshot the directives. Save the local reports. Gather the proof that the administrative state has abandoned its duty to protect. Step 2: Personalize the Cost. The numbers are staggering--but numbers alone do not move people. Stories do. Tell me how this crisis has touched your family, your neighborhood, your community. Personalize the cost of bureaucratic failure. Make it real. Make it human. Step 3: Send Me the Proof. Forward your evidence to evidence@americankitchentable.com. Every piece of evidence strengthens the case. Every story adds weight to the strike. Every voice that joins makes the structural case for the REINS Act and the constitutional recalibration Madison designed. Send me the proof, and I will carry it to the floor of Congress as evidence for the REINS Act. Every story, every statistic, every shattered family becomes a weapon in the fight to restore constitutional accountability. Forward, Always The establishment treats border enforcement as discretionary. I will treat it as a constitutional mandate. The establishment allows bureaucrats to open the gates without your vote. I will force them to face the people's representatives. The establishment accepts 5,622 deaths as inevitable. I refuse to surrender. Vote. Fuel. Fight. The common defence is not discretionary--it is a constitutional mandate. Vote Ivette Palomo and The American Kitchen Table on . Fuel the Strike with Fight To Win! Strike the root. Secure the table. name: Josh Shapiro
subject: It’s official

body:
The primary is behind us. Now, we have to win the fight ahead.
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260520_2.2hBFSc&refcode=em20260520-2&t=1&akid=6743%2E582294%2Ekf2rP8)
It’s Governor Josh Shapiro.
I’m a dad, a husband, the son of a pediatrician and a teacher. **Now, I’m the official Democratic nominee in my reelection campaign for the Governor of Pennsylvania.**
Growing up, my parents taught me about the responsibility to help others and repair the world around us.
Those lessons have guided me my whole life — as a State Rep, County Commissioner, as Attorney General, and now as Governor.
When I-95 collapsed in Pennsylvania, we rebuilt it in 12 days. When families needed relief, we cut taxes. When kids needed a fair shot, we invested in public schools and delivered free breakfast.
And when Donald Trump and the far-right threatened our freedoms, I stood up and fought back.
**Now, I’m running for reelection because all of that progress is on the line.**
But, Pennsylvania is one of the toughest battleground states in the country. Trump won here in 2024, and National Republicans think they can win here again. I know we can stop them, but I’ll need every bit of support I can muster.
**[So I’m humbly asking: Will you chip in a donation of any amount — split evenly between our campaign and Chris Pappas — to help us reach our first $25,000 fundraising goal of the general election, win this race on November 3rd, and keep Pennsylvania moving forward?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260520_2.2hBFSc&refcode=em20260520-2&t=2&akid=6743%2E582294%2Ekf2rP8)**

Josh Shapiro

Friend, Most members of Congress are millionaires who are out of touch with their constituents’ needs and views. Rather than working to lower costs, some members of Congress are seeking to send $70 billion taxpayer dollars to ICE and Border Patrol this week. **The millionaire congressman in the congressional district next door to mine** spent over $17 million of his own wealth to bankroll his congressional campaigns. Even with his wealth he **takes money from corporate PACs, and AIPAC’s network has spent millions to support him.** This genocide enabler also spent more taxpayer money than any other member of Congress on ads to promote himself in 2024. **And, he voted to give ICE access to our private information while simultaneously thanking ICE as this rogue agency terrorizes our communities.** **That’s why we need to elect Donavan McKinney, who’s running for this seat in Congress.** While serving at Michigan’s largest healthcare union and in Michigan’s State House, **Donavan has led fights to secure workers’ rights, get big money out of politics, and ensure access to clean air and water.** Like me, Donavan grew up working-class in the shadows of corporate polluters in Detroit. He has spent his career fighting against corporate polluters and war mongers that poison and kill our children, and he refuses to take money from corporate PACs. name: KAREN CRNKOVICH FOR JOHNSON COUNTY COMMISSION
subject: Don’t Let a Small Number of Voters Determine Everything.... Join the team and help win the battle
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY KAREN CRNKOVICH FOR JOHNSON COUNTY COMMISSION * 6709 West 119th Street * Ste
body:
Voting is always critical, let's make sure that we get this across the finishline, I need your help!

| | | | | |
---
| |

Dear Peter,Johnson County turns out in huge numbers for presidential elections. But when it comes to local elections that directly impact your property taxes, county spending, and leadership, turnout often drops below 25 percent, and primary turnout can fall into the single digits.That means a small fraction of voters are making decisions that affect all of us.**Think about that!** If we want different results, we need more people engaged now, not just in the final weeks before Election Day.That is why we are building momentum early, and we need your help.You can make a real impact by helping us:
• Walk in parades and connect with voters
• Door knocking and having conversations in neighborhoods
• Hosting or attending meet and greets

---
|
---
| |

This is how change happens when people step up and get involved.
---
| [JOIN THE TEAM TODAY](https://us.list-manage.com/1936k7Mjpaz?e=7320325a61&c2id=7adf4106091b2bdf32986c5b36d3a494)
---
| |

Whether you have a few hours or want to take on a larger role, there is a place for you on this team.Together, we can increase turnout, restore accountability, and bring stronger leadership to Johnson County.Now is the time to start.With determination,
Karen Crnkovich
Candidate for Johnson County Commission Chair

| | | Peter, Last night was a massive night for the Pennsylvania Working Families Party. PA WFP went _six for six_ in our targeted US House and Pennsylvania House primary races. **Six races. Six Working Families victories. Clean sweep.** 🧹 Across the Commonwealth, voters chose bold, people-powered candidates in some of the toughest and most important contested primaries on the ballot. We took on crowded fields, incumbents, political insiders, corporate-backed attacks, and the old way of doing politics. **And we won every single targeted race.** **[Will you make a donation today to help PA WFP keep organizing, keep winning, and keep building the power we need for November?](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqt1KgGElNLHWwWbO_pXXNSCW45h4fBpaJjjhCrOdI_bqZ5jfeeCCChSYuRam_Yyjyofipam_rga2VBSHdoCO_pKSRNerKyj3lXF2y6Y6xQ6lDHXqZGnH26k0hQgqdQFjsIfgsyarHwbdJaciheXF5mLytTMC4-Fqs81jMIkjguhgDdwTKTJmAt3dJuUG-bDfDnAjLv71O7xXC92E2wVdVxZemp9hIMSwZ0Gh5rn9mRsvCkrVTnsFL-aI9APUyCvh8AbNvIGrwNValRcAdPxXBeB-Mx9tqf-CHBo9LXtC3rDgoPW0qdan2UQ8Bgw-dn8u-nPCDXHuGQt2T5TsCht-lP_/4qs/gyNEjF2XTLiltSkATflV4g/h0/h001.Vvr7CqG3hxnyLIKVpAxe3SSCd8pHU-NvFhazv8etb5U)** **[Donate](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqt1KgGElNLHWwWbO_pXXNSCW45h4fBpaJjjhCrOdI_bqZ5jfeeCCChSYuRam_Yyjyofipam_rga2VBSHdoCO_pK9pQU6LjGquewKl64xGH7s3TyFxouS3AhcGIq9dMqOkgYmb_Uf4jehqmRG99CVXo-XKzlSzcgUCBTPF-Y2pbSuzKsHecVAQlrwWkdlXPcSX6apfxsCDOmUh-veAEUQahk50FEFYah6KZuaSNxPiNG-VFNNChiaWJbwkbGkE9qNzQO1c0fBESqH3_KPZe5mJLRnBEQA8GEkDq4n6eXM_xZeNjNOloWN63BrtQxIRCDtJvS7hgW6wPnh5diRMI6VucA/4qs/gyNEjF2XTLiltSkATflV4g/h1/h001.gu8SLT7nELNWKlFvlVCCGmtJKKAjnmTDSRuE4EY2l9A)** Here are the incredible victories our movement helped deliver:
1. **Chris Rabb won the Democratic primary for PA-03** In one of the most closely watched congressional primaries in the country, Chris Rabb came out on top in a crowded and competitive field. This is a historic victory for Philadelphia progressives and for everyone who believes we need leaders in Congress who will fight boldly for working people.
2. **Bob Brooks won the Democratic primary for PA-07** Bob Brooks, a union firefighter and working-class champion, won a competitive primary in one of the most important congressional districts in the country. Now we have a real opportunity to flip PA-07 in November and send a fighter for working families to Congress.
3. **Sierra McNeil won in HD-195** Sierra McNeil, a social worker and advocate, defeated a Democratic incumbent who co-sponsored multiple Republican-led bills. Her victory sends a clear message: voters want leaders who are rooted in community, accountable to working people, and ready to fight for the values we share.
4. **Chris Johnson won in HD-200** Chris Johnson, an education advocate and School District of Philadelphia staffer, won the open seat vacated by Chris Rabb. This victory keeps a Working Families champion in this seat fighting for strong schools, safe communities, and real investment in working people.
5. **Ce-Ce Gerlach won in HD-22** In the Lehigh Valley, Ce-Ce Gerlach defeated an incumbent and delivered a major victory for community organizing, courageous leadership, and a politics that puts people first.
6. **Brittany Bloam won in HD-45** In Allegheny County, Brittany Bloam, a Pittsburgh-based attorney, won her primary to fill an open state House seat. Her victory is a powerful statement that working parents, organizers, and everyday people belong in office.

**These were not easy races. These were contested primaries where voters had real choices. And in race after race, voters chose Working Families champions.** That matters. It means our party is _growing_. It means our organizing is _working_. It means the status quo is _losing_ its grip. And it means voters across Pennsylvania are _ready_ for bold leaders who have the courage to stand with working people instead of corporate special interests. **At a time when national politics can feel dark and overwhelming, Pennsylvania showed something different last night.** We showed what happens when the left comes together. We showed what happens when we build a multiracial, multigenerational movement that meets the moment. We showed what happens when PA WFP goes all in. We win. **To every volunteer who knocked doors, made calls, sent texts, chipped in, talked to neighbors, and believed in these campaigns: thank you.** You helped make last night possible. Now we need to bring this momentum into November. We have seats to flip, power to build, and Working Families champions to send to Congress and Harrisburg. **[Will you make a donation today to help PA WFP keep building the power we need for November?](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqt1KgGElNLHWwWbO_pXXNSCW45h4fBpaJjjhCrOdI_bqZ5jfeeCCChSYuRam_Yyjyofipam_rga2VBSHdoCO_pK2PR7PNkZOnayW07rTvrtOrNQlCxF7nJg9V9HnHw79hkrhoweV0duvLIT0tDKAY5YY70fFhimtxA_Xvk6ANippSjW0-Hd-naDqXHWCEcu_-zmiBdQES2RXl8g5ROkgRMnluc4euGFzL9KDtgByweO2v_H2h4usSMhdpER_FMGz_s9L1ZNjw_6qIExpAmzc-h7LLMiVLHpjFBoEfOK6sm2h-c56PLkSLXCFvRpiVDqZd-NcGtb9oYbJQCptc-ZVSf_/4qs/gyNEjF2XTLiltSkATflV4g/h2/h001.xTw4WHEc0C71ZEp-KV-RfE8jHHwYVjYh_8G9ivII06c)** **[Donate](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqt1KgGElNLHWwWbO_pXXNSCW45h4fBpaJjjhCrOdI_bqZ5jfeeCCChSYuRam_Yyjyofipam_rga2VBSHdoCO_pKDTO_3q9m0072eD-mdV5JGo_NC8khTsh0lJr5Akh7O0sXLyMEI6VsboJbVj5-b4NfarXMg1qSlLEzaGnfbTK3BjiBmoYMm9hwQ_dbKbf_B0NU1BukW-crLvNJp57k9GetIgBkuh9UCpWl0BQCO_HTsfHAJKN84f4qKzcHl1T9wpSwiv5Fox4OvW2Iyfb5xo3YtP3qz0TFHvW9YpSOHeMaY0nzFhgxyTZqUSM6YFVAK9rEngL027BPWtKDCn56dth4/4qs/gyNEjF2XTLiltSkATflV4g/h3/h001.UzD9XaGqeoBk63uERsSXSwr3-sPff21l_rWxANSxras)** Your contribution will help us talk to voters, recruit and train volunteers, support Working Families champions, and take on the corporate-backed forces already preparing to spend big against our movement. body:
From Navy helicopter pilot to Congress
| Peter,
I know your inbox is probably overflowing right now with politicians begging for your hard-earned money using every scare tactic in the book.
I truly hate having to send messages like this, but I really appreciate your time!
My last message didn't get the response I was hoping for, and now I'm starting to feel like we're falling behind. We can't keep fighting if we don't have the resources to keep the lights on and pay my amazing staff.
Let me take a second to re-introduce myself: My name is Jen Kiggans.
I am a former Navy helicopter pilot. I flew H-46s and H-3s in the Persian Gulf. After my time in the military, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a board-certified Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. I am married to a retired Navy F/A-18 pilot, and now I am a proud Navy Mom.
