_Thank you, Georgia!_
After last night’s primary, I am officially the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Georgia.
This race in Georgia is likely to be the most competitive and expensive U.S. Senate race in 2026. I am the *only* endangered Democratic incumbent U.S. Senator in the midterms. Republicans are preparing to unleash massive resources attacking me and this seat.
But our victory will be powered once again by overwhelming grassroots support.
If you know the stakes and how important your support is — and if you are ready to make a donation to help start the general election in the strongest position possible — please use this link: [**https://act.electjon.com/go/General-Election**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-may26.KE07xH&refcode=em260520-2-subs&t=4&akid=2286%2E5691347%2EEw4q1W)
Otherwise, let me tell you a bit about why I ran for Senate — and why this moment is just as urgent.
Before I was elected, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. We exposed wrongdoing in countries where criticizing the government is dangerous, where whistleblowers and witnesses will only meet in secret, where protest carries the risk of prosecution.
More and more, the atmosphere under Trump has reminded me of those places — places where dissent was silenced by intimidation and where unaccountable elites plunder and trade power for profit with impunity.
I ran for Senate because I saw that Trump’s election endangered our Republic and I was determined to confront him and the corruption that made his rise possible.
_And Peter, that work isn’t over yet._
**This is not a drill and it’s not a bad dream. As citizens, it’s the test of our lifetimes.**
So please, I’m humbly asking: [**Make a contribution to my reelection campaign. Do it today and help us start the general election in the strongest possible position.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-may26.KE07xH&refcode=em260520-2-subs&t=5&akid=2286%2E5691347%2EEw4q1W)

We know MAGA’s election playbook: _Lie. Enrage. Distract._
And between the Fulton County raid, the executive order attacking voting, and the plotting of the MAGA loyalists on our state election board... they've made their plans very clear.
But we’ve beaten them before — _right here in Georgia._
In 2021, we defeated an entrenched GOP incumbent by staying on offense and organizing a turnout effort totally unprecedented in its scale and intensity.
**This is the next test.**
And the best insurance against MAGA’s dirty tricks is _landslide margins of victory._
My team is preparing a larger-than-ever-before effort to get out the vote and defend voting rights.
That work is not easy or cheap. We have to work relentlessly through Election Day, and we need the resources to reach every single voter.
[**Peter, I have to ask: Can you please make a donation to my reelection campaign and help us start the general election strong?**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-may26.KE07xH&refcode=em260520-2-subs&t=7&akid=2286%2E5691347%2EEw4q1W)
The average donation to this campaign is around $30. Many give less. Some give more. **What matters is that we show strength in numbers — _and that we show it now._**
**[DONATE](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-may26.KE07xH&refcode=em260520-2-subs&t=8&akid=2286%2E5691347%2EEw4q1W)**
Thank you so much.
\- Jon

**By Wendy M. Yurgo**
On Saturday, tens of thousands of Britons flooded the streets of London.
Families. Veterans. Christians carrying wooden crosses. Iranian exiles flying the Lion and Sun flag. Ordinary people who believe their concerns over immigration, cultural fragmentation, public safety, and national identity have been ignored for too long.
Two days later, the political establishment is still trying to process what happened.
The march was not simply about Britain.
It was a warning to the rest of the West.
Because many conservatives now believe the same tensions Britain spent years dismissing are beginning to emerge here in the United States, and nowhere more visibly than Texas.
And unlike Britain, Texas still has time to confront these battles before they become even more politically and culturally combustible.
## **The Blueprint**
Britain did not wake up one morning and suddenly arrive at this moment. It happened gradually. Policy by policy. Court ruling by court ruling. Accommodation by accommodation. While the media mocked anyone who raised concerns and political leaders assured citizens everything was under control.
Now Texas is watching similar fights emerge in real time.
Forty miles northeast of Dallas, a 402-acre Muslim-centric development known as EPIC City, later rebranded "The Meadow," has become the center of one of the most explosive political and legal battles in the country. The proposed development includes more than 1,000 homes, a mosque, retail infrastructure, senior living, and a K-12 Islamic school. In promotional material later deleted after public backlash, organizers described the project as intended to become "the epicenter of Islam in America."
As conservatives sounded the alarm, developers quietly rebranded the project and the lawsuits quickly followed.

Attorney General Ken Paxton sued over the project's proposed utility district. HUD launched an investigation. A state bench trial is now scheduled for November 2026.
This is not internet rumor or social media paranoia. This is an active, documented legal and political fight unfolding inside Texas.
Meanwhile, the East Plano Islamic Center, tied to the broader EPIC network, has experienced such rapid growth that overflow rooms have become necessary during services. Some Muslim publications have described the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex as "the Medina of America" as the region's Muslim population and infrastructure continue expanding. Reports estimate the area now contains more than sixty Sunni mosques.
Houston is not far behind. Greater Houston reportedly has more than two hundred mosques and Islamic centers and is home to the largest Muslim population in the Southern United States.
This is not a small or temporary demographic shift. It is a growing and permanent population building institutions, schools, financial systems, and political influence while Texas leaders scramble to determine where the legal and cultural boundaries actually are.

## **The Shadow Court**
EPIC City is not the only front in this fight.
In April 2026, Attorney General Ken Paxton announced what he called a landmark investigation into a Dallas-based group known as the Islamic Tribunal. According to the Texas Attorney General's office, the organization claimed authority over disputes involving Muslim Texans and falsely represented that its rulings carried "the approval of the Texas Judicial system."
Paxton argued the matter crossed from protected religious arbitration into potentially deceptive representations about legal authority inside the state of Texas.

His warning was direct:
_" Anyone or any entity that seeks to subvert the codified state and federal laws of this country will be stopped dead in their tracks. This is America, and we will not be governed by Sharia law."_
Following the investigation, reports indicated the Islamic Tribunal modified portions of its website and public descriptions of its role.
Britain did not arrive at parallel legal and cultural systems through one dramatic declaration. It happened quietly, institution by institution, while political leaders insisted citizens ignore what was plainly visible.
## **Your Tax Dollars, Their Schools**
Texas conservatives fought for years to pass school choice.
The Texas Education Freedom Accounts program, a $1 billion initiative providing families with roughly $10,000 per student for private education, was championed as a lifeline for parents fleeing failing public schools. It was sold to much of the Texas electorate as a parental rights revolution, particularly for Christian and Jewish families seeking alternatives to collapsing public education.
Then the lawsuits started.
Islamic schools connected to CAIR affiliates sought access to taxpayer-funded vouchers. Governor Greg Abbott publicly opposed extending funds to schools he believed promoted radical ideology. Paxton backed the effort. State officials initially refused certification.
Then a federal judge intervened.
The court ordered Texas officials to reconsider the applications and extend the window for Islamic schools to apply. Following court intervention, Islamic schools were allowed back into the application process, forcing Texas into a political and legal battle many conservatives never expected the program to create.
Many Texas voters never imagined the school choice fight would end here. But once the state created a taxpayer-funded education system without meaningful ideological boundaries, the expansion became inevitable. Courts, not voters, would ultimately decide who qualifies.
Now Texas taxpayers are being forced into a debate many never realized they were having in the first place: should the public be compelled to fund religious and ideological systems fundamentally at odds with the values many supporters believed the program was created to protect?
Britain learned this lesson years ago through publicly funded faith schools and parallel educational systems. Texas is now confronting the same debate at extraordinary speed.

## **The CAIR Battle**
In late 2025, Governor Abbott designated CAIR and the Muslim Brotherhood as foreign terrorist organizations and transnational criminal organizations under Texas authority, though neither group holds that designation at the federal level.
Abbott also directed the Texas Department of Public Safety to open criminal investigations into both organizations and their affiliates.
CAIR immediately challenged the actions in federal court.
At the same time, schools tied to CAIR-linked networks were seeking access to Texas taxpayer-funded voucher dollars after judicial intervention forced reconsideration of their applications.
The contradiction was impossible to ignore: federal courts were expanding access to taxpayer-funded programs while Texas officials were simultaneously investigating the very organizations tied to them.

## **The Communities Texans Are Now Debating Openly**
Texas Congressman Chip Roy said publicly during the primaries that parts of the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex have become areas where some Texans feel increasingly culturally displaced and uncomfortable.
The media immediately labeled the comments Islamophobic.
But residents in Collin County have continued showing up to public meetings expressing fears over rapid demographic and cultural transformation they believe was never openly debated with voters.
Britain has spent years dealing with similar tensions while political leaders and media outlets dismissed critics as extremists until frustration finally exploded into the open.
Texas still has time to confront these issues democratically before resentment hardens into the kind of political fracture now consuming parts of Europe.
## **The Ballot and the Battle**
Early voting is already underway for the May 26 Texas Republican Primary Runoff.
These races are not abstract political theater. They will shape how Texas handles immigration, religious liberty, school choice, local governance, and the growing legal battles surrounding developments like EPIC City.
Ken Paxton has aggressively positioned himself at the center of nearly every major fight described above. He sued over EPIC City's utility district, launched the Islamic Tribunal investigation, fought the inclusion of Islamic schools in the voucher program, and pushed investigations tied to CAIR and the Muslim Brotherhood.
Paxton has built a reputation among conservatives for engaging fights that most officials sidestep, taking on legal battles directly rather than issuing carefully worded statements from a distance.

What separates him is not just aggression. It is strategy. Paxton understands how institutional battles are actually won. He identifies pressure points, forces legal confrontations, and moves aggressively while others are still debating whether the fight is even worth having.
Whether the issue is immigration, election integrity, federal overreach, Big Tech censorship, or now the growing battles surrounding EPIC City and parallel legal systems, Paxton repeatedly takes fights most politicians avoid and drags them directly into court and public view.
These elections matter far more than many Texans seem willing to admit.
And if conservatives sit home assuming someone else will handle it, they do not get to wake up years from now asking how Texas changed so quickly.
Political transformation rarely happens all at once. It unfolds election by election, race by race, while millions stay disengaged believing someone else will hold the line.
## **What London Just Showed The West**
The people who marched in London were not marching because they hated their country.
They marched because they loved it.
They believe Britain is still worth fighting for.

Support PolitiBrawl by becoming a paid subscriber today: By Wendy M. Yurgo On Saturday, tens of thousands of Britons flooded the streets of London. Families. Veterans. Christians carrying wooden crosses. Iranian exiles flying the Lion and Sun flag. Ordinary people who believe their concerns over immigration, cultural fragmentation, public safety, and national identity have been ignored for too long. Two days later, the political establishment is still trying to process what happened. The march was not simply about Britain. It was a warning to the rest of the West. Because many conservatives now believe the same tensions Britain spent years dismissing are beginning to emerge here in the United States, and nowhere more visibly than Texas. And unlike Britain, Texas still has time to confront these battles before they become even more politically and culturally combustible. The Blueprint Britain did not wake up one morning and suddenly arrive at this moment. It happened gradually. Policy by policy. Court ruling by court ruling. Accommodation by accommodation. While the media mocked anyone who raised concerns and political leaders assured citizens everything was under control. Now Texas is watching similar fights emerge in real time. Forty miles northeast of Dallas, a 402-acre Muslim-centric development known as EPIC City, later rebranded "The Meadow," has become the center of one of the most explosive political and legal battles in the country. The proposed development includes more than 1,000 homes, a mosque, retail infrastructure, senior living, and a K-12 Islamic school. In promotional material later deleted after public backlash, organizers described the project as intended to become "the epicenter of Islam in America." As conservatives sounded the alarm, developers quietly rebranded the project and the lawsuits quickly followed. Attorney General Ken Paxton sued over the project's proposed utility district. HUD launched an investigation. A state bench trial is now scheduled for November 2026. This is not internet rumor or social media paranoia. This is an active, documented legal and political fight unfolding inside Texas. Meanwhile, the East Plano Islamic Center, tied to the broader EPIC network, has experienced such rapid growth that overflow rooms have become necessary during services. Some Muslim publications have described the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex as "the Medina of America" as the region's Muslim population and infrastructure continue expanding. Reports estimate the area now contains more than sixty Sunni mosques. Houston is not far behind. Greater Houston reportedly has more than two hundred mosques and Islamic centers and is home to the largest Muslim population in the Southern United States. This is not a small or temporary demographic shift. It is a growing and permanent population building institutions, schools, financial systems, and political influence while Texas leaders scramble to determine where the legal and cultural boundaries actually are. A message from our sponsor (piece continues below) From selling Pokemon cards to disrupting a $1 trillion industry | | ---|---|--- Mark Cuban delivered local papers, Warren Buffet sold packs of gum, Richard Branson bred parakeets... Today's wealthiest business leaders started their entrepreneur journeys at a young age. And Dan Novaes' story is no different. From selling Pokemon cards at the age of 7 to founding Mode Mobile, Dan's EarnPhone has led to over $1B in savings for their ecosystem of over 490M users worldwide. His company was ranked the by Deloitte and plans are underway for a potential IPO on the Nasdaq (ticker: MODE). From humble beginnings to generating over 32,481% revenue growth from 2019-2022, Mode Mobile is , and the opportunity to invest in Mode's vision at $0.50/share is live. But this window is closing fast. 🚨 Last chance to invest at $0.50/share. Price changes on 05/29. Disclosures *Mode Mobile recently received their ticker reservation with Nasdaq ($MODE), indicating an intent to IPO in the next 24 months. An intent to IPO is no guarantee that an actual IPO will occur. *The Deloitte rankings are based on submitted applications and public company database research, with winners selected based on their fiscal-year revenue growth percentage over a three-year period. *Please read the offering circular and related risks at invest.modemobile.com. (Piece contines) The Shadow Court EPIC City is not the only front in this fight. In April 2026, Attorney General Ken Paxton announced what he called a landmark investigation into a Dallas-based group known as the Islamic Tribunal. According to the Texas Attorney General's office, the organization claimed authority over disputes involving Muslim Texans and falsely represented that its rulings carried "the approval of the Texas Judicial system." Paxton argued the matter crossed from protected religious arbitration into potentially deceptive representations about legal authority inside the state of Texas. His warning was direct: " Anyone or any entity that seeks to subvert the codified state and federal laws of this country will be stopped dead in their tracks. This is America, and we will not be governed by Sharia law." Following the investigation, reports indicated the Islamic Tribunal modified portions of its website and public descriptions of its role. Britain did not arrive at parallel legal and cultural systems through one dramatic declaration. It happened quietly, institution by institution, while political leaders insisted citizens ignore what was plainly visible. Your Tax Dollars, Their Schools Texas conservatives fought for years to pass school choice. The Texas Education Freedom Accounts program, a $1 billion initiative providing families with roughly $10,000 per student for private education, was championed as a lifeline for parents fleeing failing public schools. It was sold to much of the Texas electorate as a parental rights revolution, particularly for Christian and Jewish families seeking alternatives to collapsing public education. Then the lawsuits started. Islamic schools connected to CAIR affiliates sought access to taxpayer-funded vouchers. Governor Greg Abbott publicly opposed extending funds to schools he believed promoted radical ideology. Paxton backed the effort. State officials initially refused certification. Then a federal judge intervened. The court ordered Texas officials to reconsider the applications and extend the window for Islamic schools to apply. Following court intervention, Islamic schools were allowed back into the application process, forcing Texas into a political and legal battle many conservatives never expected the program to create. Many Texas voters never imagined the school choice fight would end here. But once the state created a taxpayer-funded education system without meaningful ideological boundaries, the expansion became inevitable. Courts, not voters, would ultimately decide who qualifies. Now Texas taxpayers are being forced into a debate many never realized they were having in the first place: should the public be compelled to fund religious and ideological systems fundamentally at odds with the values many supporters believed the program was created to protect? Britain learned this lesson years ago through publicly funded faith schools and parallel educational systems. Texas is now confronting the same debate at extraordinary speed. (Piece continues below) Are you enjoying PolitiBrawl 's bold and ruthless coverage? With 1.7 million daily readers, PolitiBrawl is now the largest conservative publication on Substack! We didn't get that way by pulling our punches! on information. If we are going to take back our country, we must win the media wars. It is not an option. President Trump agrees. | | ---|---|--- will be used to FAIRLY cover President Trump's administration and aggressively hold the Democrats accountable because God knows CNN and the New York Times won't do it! This is why CNN hates us, because we are waking up more American's every day to their lies. Thank you for your support and for joining the fight alongside us. \- The PolitiBrawl editors (piece continues) The CAIR Battle In late 2025, Governor Abbott designated CAIR and the Muslim Brotherhood as foreign terrorist organizations and transnational criminal organizations under Texas authority, though neither group holds that designation at the federal level. Abbott also directed the Texas Department of Public Safety to open criminal investigations into both organizations and their affiliates. CAIR immediately challenged the actions in federal court. At the same time, schools tied to CAIR-linked networks were seeking access to Texas taxpayer-funded voucher dollars after judicial intervention forced reconsideration of their applications. The contradiction was impossible to ignore: federal courts were expanding access to taxpayer-funded programs while Texas officials were simultaneously investigating the very organizations tied to them. The Communities Texans Are Now Debating Openly Texas Congressman Chip Roy said publicly during the primaries that parts of the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex have become areas where some Texans feel increasingly culturally displaced and uncomfortable. The media immediately labeled the comments Islamophobic. But residents in Collin County have continued showing up to public meetings expressing fears over rapid demographic and cultural transformation they believe was never openly debated with voters. Britain has spent years dealing with similar tensions while political leaders and media outlets dismissed critics as extremists until frustration finally exploded into the open. Texas still has time to confront these issues democratically before resentment hardens into the kind of political fracture now consuming parts of Europe. The Ballot and the Battle Early voting is already underway for the May 26 Texas Republican Primary Runoff. These races are not abstract political theater. They will shape how Texas handles immigration, religious liberty, school choice, local governance, and the growing legal battles surrounding developments like EPIC City. Ken Paxton has aggressively positioned himself at the center of nearly every major fight described above. He sued over EPIC City's utility district, launched the Islamic Tribunal investigation, fought the inclusion of Islamic schools in the voucher program, and pushed investigations tied to CAIR and the Muslim Brotherhood. Paxton has built a reputation among conservatives for engaging fights that most officials sidestep, taking on legal battles directly rather than issuing carefully worded statements from a distance. What separates him is not just aggression. It is strategy. Paxton understands how institutional battles are actually won. He identifies pressure points, forces legal confrontations, and moves aggressively while others are still debating whether the fight is even worth having. Whether the issue is immigration, election integrity, federal overreach, Big Tech censorship, or now the growing battles surrounding EPIC City and parallel legal systems, Paxton repeatedly takes fights most politicians avoid and drags them directly into court and public view. These elections matter far more than many Texans seem willing to admit. And if conservatives sit home assuming someone else will handle it, they do not get to wake up years from now asking how Texas changed so quickly. Political transformation rarely happens all at once. It unfolds election by election, race by race, while millions stay disengaged believing someone else will hold the line. What London Just Showed The West The people who marched in London were not marching because they hated their country. They marched because they loved it. They believe Britain is still worth fighting for. Must-read: | | | | ---|---|--- | May 17 | For years, ordinary citizens watched political leaders dismiss concerns over immigration, cultural fragmentation, public safety, and national identity as backward or dangerous. Now those same issues are exploding into the open across Britain, forcing conversations the establishment spent years trying to shut down. The crowds in London were not signs of surrender. They were signs of awakening. Britain is fighting back. And Texas should pay attention to both the warning and the awakening. Texas is not Britain. Not yet. Texas still has elections that matter. Texas still has leaders willing to fight publicly over these issues. Texas still has a population capable of confronting these debates before the fractures deepen further. But the window does not stay open forever. Every court ruling narrowing state authority narrows it further. Every institutional battle delayed narrows it further. Every voter who stays home because politics feels exhausting narrows it further. Britain waited too long to confront many of these battles openly. Now millions of Britons are demanding their leaders finally listen. Texas still has the opportunity to act before the fight becomes that intense. Texas still has a ballot. Use it while it still matters. About the Author** Wendy M. Hey folks,
**Don Lemon** and I jumped right in. We talked about the growing anger people feel toward billionaires, CEOs, and a political system that seems completely disconnected from what everyday Americans are actually living through right now. Gas prices are up. Housing is unaffordable. Child care is crushing families. And meanwhile, the richest people on earth are telling everyone things are going great.
**Here 's what we got into:**
* [**00:01:07**] Mike reacts to Trump saying he doesn't think about Americans' financial struggles -- and why the outrage around it feels completely muted.
* [**00:05:12**] The conversation turns to Jeff Bezos defending Trump and arguing higher taxes on billionaires wouldn't help ordinary people.
* [**00:09:32**] Don brings up Luigi Mangione and the disturbing public reaction around him -- and what it says about growing rage toward the billionaire class.
* [**00:13:09**] Mike explains why economic desperation and political corruption are pushing people toward dangerous levels of hopelessness and distrust.
* [**00:17:38**] The episode somehow spirals into a debate about Jeff Bezos looking like Pitbull -- plus why wealth clearly isn't buying happiness for America's richest people.

This episode is really about one thing: people are exhausted. They're tired of being told the economy is "strong" while they can barely afford groceries, rent, health care, or child care. We talked about the collapse of trust in institutions, the growing resentment toward billionaires who seem totally detached from reality, and why both parties need to understand just how angry and desperate people are becoming. If you care about where this country is heading -- economically, politically, and culturally -- this conversation is essential listening.

I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground.

Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible.
---

_Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona_
---
These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.

That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens.

And it's not isolated growth anymore.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida
✅ Idaho
✅ Indiana
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Oklahoma
✅ South Carolina
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action.

That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly.

It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up.

Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through.

And right now, that's where we're stretched.

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

We're working to keep up with both.

_So here 's how you can help... _

Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it.

**An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: **

✅ Constitutions.
✅ Chapter guides.
✅ Flags.
✅ Materials to organize and lead.

It turns a student who wants to speak up... _into one who actually does. _

And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here."

But moments like this don't sustain themselves.

If we don't keep up, we lose ground. It's that simple.

**We need to keep pace with the growth happening right now -- to fund more activism kits, support more chapters, and make sure no student is left standing alone after they decide to speak up. **

If you've already supported Turning Point USA in the past, thank you for carrying this movement forward every single day.

If you haven't yet, I'm asking you to step in now.

clean_body: A quick look at what’s happening right now | | | | | Friend, I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground. Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible. Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them. They're already claimed. And we don't have extras. By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in. Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it. That's where things stand right now. We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment. And I don't say that lightly. Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down. The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great. And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing. Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back. We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there. And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet. That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens. And it's not isolated growth anymore. We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America. That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation... And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak. So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build. What's different now is the pace. Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: ✅ Arkansas ✅ Florida ✅ Idaho ✅ Indiana ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Oklahoma ✅ South Carolina ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action. That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly. It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up. Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through. And right now, that's where we're stretched. We're not lacking interest or momentum. We're working to keep up with both. So here 's how you can help... Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it. An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: ✅ Constitutions. ✅ Chapter guides. ✅ Flags. ✅ Materials to organize and lead. It turns a student who wants to speak up... into one who actually does. And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here." Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines. That's how we keep saying "yes" when the next student steps forward. That's how this movement actually scales. Because the reality is, the demand is here now. The only question is whether we're equipped to meet it. And that comes down to whether people like you decide to step in and help carry this forward. One final thing: I also wanted to say thank you. If you've supported Turning Point USA before -- whether once or many times -- you've already played a role in building what you're seeing right now. Students finding their voice. More state partnerships. New TPUSA chapters like the one at Charlie's former high school. This kind of momentum doesn't happen without people willing to stand behind it. And we don't take that lightly. I appreciate you taking the time to read this, and for everything you've already done to support this work. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. Friend, what you're seeing right now is something we've been working toward for years -- a generation of young Americans who are no longer willing to sit quietly while the Left dominates their schools and culture. But moments like this don't sustain themselves. If we don't keep up, we lose ground. It's that simple. We need to keep pace with the growth happening right now -- to fund more activism kits, support more chapters, and make sure no student is left standing alone after they decide to speak up. If you've already supported Turning Point USA in the past, thank you for carrying this movement forward every single day. If you haven't yet, I'm asking you to step in now. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

subject: I’ll never accuse you of abandoning us
body:
Insulting...
After all you’ve done for our Party, I salute you, Peter!

| Peter,
---
I’m sick of seeing text messages that accuse you of abandoning the GOP after all you’ve done for us.
All because you didn’t give $15 before some random deadline, that’s supposed to mean you **_“betrayed”_** the Republican Party and became a Democrat?
So all the times you stood in line to vote, you knocked on doors, you put up a yard sign, you made phone calls, you filled out surveys, you sacrificed your time and money – suddenly, all of that means nothing?
**_Give me a break! That’s just insulting._**
_Hand to God, I will never stoop to that low._
Truth be told, I try not to write too many emails and texts as it is. I’m busy working in Washington to do the job you asked me to do.
Honestly, fundraising just isn’t Priority #1.
At the end of 2024, I transferred $2.5 MILLION _**away**_ from my own campaign to help conservatives in tough races who _truly_ needed help.
**You know what I care about most?** The _ONLY_ thing that WINS elections – **_VOTES_**.
_That means registering voters, verifying every Trump voter’s profile, and constantly getting LIVE feedback from voters like you so that the President and I _always_ have the best, most accurate data in the country._
That’s how we won in 2024. And it’s my plan to win AGAIN in 2026.

Peter, gas prices are continuing to skyrocket thanks to Trump’s illegal wars.
This week, Georgia’s governor suspended the gas tax in the state for another two weeks. That’s great news for Georgia families — but we didn’t get here because of Brian Kemp’s leadership. **This started with Leaders We Deserve endorsed candidate, Akbar Ali.**

Akbar is proving that for this next generation of Democrats, affordability is not just a talking point, it is an _actionable priority_ they’re uniquely prepared to address when we elect them.

Peter, Tomorrow, the Supreme Court will issue another round of decisions. No one but the Court and their staff knows what those decisions will be. But we’ll be ready. With _Louisiana v. Callais_ , the Court already gutted what was left of the Voting Rights Act—setting off racial gerrymandering in states across the country, disenfranchising millions of Black and Brown voters, and rigging the 2026 midterms and beyond in favor of Republicans. Voting rights. Gun safety. Trans kids’ rights. Dark money in politics. All four hang in the balance. And any one—or several—could be decided TOMORROW. **Let’s be clear: none of this is an accident. This Court was built by dark money to serve dark money. And it’s working exactly as intended.** [**United for Democracy was outside Congress today, where Justices cancelled their appearance to testify. We’re channeling grassroots energy to reform the Court, and we’re going to win. Can you chip in $X today to fight for reform?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsQNarR6PCR1lUtXpWTyhe6lIDH-kzde4dCytvAbrw_E_EncVQlCgXqvRL9sKtIHZcPCZItHOsSswTgYlviN7GJpWYmED5OP9i523IuQqSWg6hOH6otEfxdN-bofq87dRrRooF7gjARThBIS5uuKlx34NZlKGDUdQ5SHXg0bFb4vpHUk8JsYFE6HdYq_HYzLhVxPAddnGHIvA7oaXkwG4E8jksYHEL51kS5XLzAtySG5ON1HTpwAEg-jGiiokQLaTHmEPHgUJTYoeirQeb2USWsVRMon7UYJmvsJttfZHVE68nnVG7CslgsEaoUAOLvSMHuDqtolJf2HvjPudQxnrdciCo-HN2PD-7Fc9lSTIED3w/4qs/pMHatTnxTyK34gJd8zR8xQ/h0/h001.2VlZlnn1u_vhH1pnu1y4DqhbzxCKmJwRwKGT-RshHh4) Here’s just a glimpse of what the Court could do tomorrow:
* **_Wolford v. Lopez_** _-_ The Court could strike down another commonsense law, this time in Hawaii, **making it harder for states to keep guns out of public spaces.**
* **_West Virginia v. B.P.J._****and**** _Little v. Hecox_**** __**_-_ The Court could **uphold bans on trans children from playing sports** with their peers—building on last year's ruling that already stripped healthcare access.
* **_NRSC v. FEC_****-** Another ruling could tear down the few remaining campaign spending limits still in place after _Citizen’s United_ , **letting wealthy donors pour even more money into our elections** through political parties.

We’re watching a Supreme Court that believes it doesn’t have to answer to the people. We’re building the movement to prove them wrong. United for Democracy has prepared a coordinated response across media, organizers, and partners nationwide. With Louisiana v. Callais , the Court already gutted what was left of the Voting Rights Act—setting off racial gerrymandering in states across the country, disenfranchising millions of Black and Brown voters, and rigging the 2026 midterms and beyond in favor of Republicans. Voting rights. Gun safety. Trans kids’ rights. Dark money in politics. All four hang in the balance. And any one—or several—could be decided TOMORROW. Let’s be clear: none of this is an accident. This Court was built by dark money to serve dark money. And it’s working exactly as intended. Here’s just a glimpse of what the Court could do tomorrow: Wolford v. Lopez - The Court could strike down another commonsense law, this time in Hawaii, making it harder for states to keep guns out of public spaces. West Virginia v. B.P.J.and Little v. Hecox _- The Court could uphold bans on trans children from playing sports with their peers—building on last year's ruling that already stripped healthcare access. NRSC v. FEC**- Another ruling could tear down the few remaining campaign spending limits still in place after Citizen’s United , letting wealthy donors pour even more money into our elections through political parties. clean_body: We're in a fight for the future of this country, and there's no time to sit on the sidelines. | Peter, Our Senate Republican Primary is less than 2 weeks away, and the stakes could not be higher. The Left is pouring money into key races across the country, and we're working around the clock to make sure conservative voters in South Carolina turn out strong and send a message the Democrats can't ignore. But at midnight tonight, we face a major Federal Election Commission (FEC) filing deadline. When the clock strikes midnight, every dollar we've raised since April 1st will become public. My Democrat opponent, the liberal media, and Chuck Schumer's political machine will be combing through these numbers looking for any sign that conservatives are losing momentum. I'll be blunt: we cannot afford to look weak right now. This is one of the last major deadlines before voters begin casting their ballots, and what we report tonight will shape the narrative heading into the final stretch of this campaign. If we post strong numbers, we send a clear signal that South Carolina Republicans are energized, united, and ready to defend the conservative agenda. But if we come up short, the Left will smell opportunity. That's why I'm personally asking: We're in a fight for the future of this country - and there's no time to sit on the sidelines. Today on _**Amped Up**_ : Cliff and David Shuster open with FBI Director Kash Patel's grotesque VIP snorkeling trip over the USS Arizona war grave, dig into Trump's primary bloodbath that just took out Thomas Massie and has Ken Paxton lining up to take out John Cornyn next, and then bring on Blue Amp Media's COO **Lawrence Winnerman** --who just sat down with his shrink this morning, half-joking, to talk about why the political class is missing what is actually about to happen to the American economy.
Lawrence's new essay, _**Running with the Devil**_ , is the most comprehensive AI labor-displacement diagnosis you will read this year, and it is now being read inside congressional offices, including by Rep. **Ro Khanna**.
The conversation walks through the math: **93 million white-collar jobs at risk inside 12 to 18 months** , per Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman, said on the record with his face on the byline. It walks through the screaming inside the labs (96% blackmail rates and 95% let-the-technician-die rates in Anthropic's own published safety testing, the doomsday clock moving, the godfathers of AI quitting their jobs to warn the rest of us). It walks through the joke of a Ted Cruz / Brian Schatz Chatbot Act that pretends it is keeping up.
And it walks through Lawrence's specific anchor--the one that makes the math feel real--that he replaced **twenty-five knowledge-worker roles for $200 a month** , in six weeks, on a Costco gaming desktop in Fort Wayne, Indiana.
Hit play. Take an hour.
This is the show that connects both stories--the GOP bloodbath in front of you, and the bigger one nobody in Washington is naming.

From attempts to restrict mail-in voting and impose stricter voter ID requirements to efforts that make voter registration more difficult, coordinated attacks on our voting rights are happening across the country. Luckily, here in Colorado we have Jessie Danielson to thank for our gold-standard voting systems that make participation more accessible. She passed the Automatic Voter Registration bill, helping expand access to the ballot and register hundreds of thousands of new voters across Colorado. She expanded ballot access for voters with disabilities, so that every eligible voter can cast their vote privately and securely. She helped build and implement the Voter Access and Modernized Elections Act that created universal mail-in ballots, same-day registration, and voter service centers. There is nobody better suited to stand up and defend our elections than the person who had a hand in building the systems that govern them. name: Joe Males
subject: I want to tell you why I'm running
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MALES FOR CONGRESS
body:
A Marine. A grieving dad. A promise to keep.
Peter,

I want to tell you why I'm running, and I want to do it straight.

My son was a United States Marine. He followed me into the Corps, and he came home proud of his service. Then one night, in our own hometown, he was murdered. For a long time after that, nothing happened. No leads, no arrests, no answers — just a quiet phone and a family trying to put one foot in front of the other. I do not have the words for what that kind of waiting does to a father.

[](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=db30c315691a4515bea185ac725b2e78&_e=3EX7KXYXUztVueKaJmYKv6jdsMDmGxX5Unjx5ndYCRYU88MgCR8axed10Q8mAiwrbod4-bFMQJEuL7UmvjdP3AWzvFGw2I-RiZxl4RO6DMcPj3CUDfoG0WV11cPRhCrZHbf4qx01XswDikXCivdtPeBpududomJNT5OYNbosPnSU4zPkfWCZy1BcIO82-7oK7BxromP--G3MWqY9txO4fmFUGpV739RTbWXKxq71dRLeEeJruLRYHrugWYGtDvY_NNhLjNInvIu-R3nWAvk3HRiQgyn4LgXHl2959QXHX50lxDNBLzXhw27vFrdy9JL3-AHE3HPHaCAhZ1ymNzDZgxA_sc_l5NoncrMHgodqCVC5oxhJEIuNdYCZdYrGWZmmYQh_q3o8rHeiCOZ8d7a29YGc9dajsp7WinoXqme1LtAG7iNGSOXOO3GL4oReOgtIc97_ga3QvtGN7VcmSve_pCLuBnSzbbvvY6rqe4p7WOL8BkBKC2ySNZ8DlgVn8uAUgjnYzn4hYFiPqTBZzGWgYQ%3D%3D)
But I learned one thing in those years. Sitting still was not going to bring my son back, and it was not going to keep another family from getting the knock on the door that I got. So I made him a promise. No other dad would bury his child the way I buried mine. Not if I could help it.

I ran for Hemet City Council on that promise, and I won. Every day since, I have gone to work on public safety — better policing, cleaner streets, real consequences for the people who hurt our families. We have made real progress. But the truth is, a city can only do so much when Washington is asleep at the wheel.

**That is why I'm running for Congress.**

[ **STAND WITH JOE TODAY** ](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=db30c315691a4515bea185ac725b2e78&_e=3EX7KXYXUztVueKaJmYKv6jdsMDmGxX5Unjx5ndYCRYU88MgCR8axed10Q8mAiwrbod4-bFMQJEuL7UmvjdP3AWzvFGw2I-RiZxl4RO6DMcPj3CUDfoG0WV11cPRhCrZNLeB9z9g1vAqPfDPcFhZbfSQzEYPacgKuGrNsd3hTBKNenm7Xmh3mZ1GvZ4T3C1iMvPHTgY-Sn_CZwBRzKu5Jrl8jLfNEzEHXbRLpL7FCyln1azcm08mZOd_crdbowwyxpopbSQTHZjDisEUQklNqmLCdTX0c60S-p-QqppfR5soVioglcgWNYzaXXBbYylp7pKR50LbgdlBgDSuREgO-QSJGt7m8-EgfYLwOLt-_kpaB24vpjuWnbSttqWiGm_eBEsAOtIm9TRbXm_pRa0PXqE_UVIVPY8wG-ZIf0BQx1XygQOHGfRILPNtGcR8UdvNiNg_oXYJtxrkjaom__IqC2mMWfOZ_2Aip3cLcNqnvxZq8N5AThUo2JHJ4CJ9lJOvLcQlMnG5Y-syzVIpjcZt3oiJM0B-G1J_tYUjCU3BVEI%3D)
---

Crime is up. Our borders are open. Career politicians in D.C. cash their checks and look the other way. They don't see what we see. They don't lose what families like mine have lost. I do, and I am not going to stop fighting until that changes.

I'm a Marine. I'm a father. I'm a small business owner who knows what it takes to make a payroll for 22 years. I'm not slick, I'm not polished, and I’m not for sale. I am one man who made a promise to his son, and I am keeping it the only way I know how.

**But I cannot get to Washington on my own, Peter.** **[A gift of $10 helps me knock on another door. A gift of $25 helps me put another ad on the air. Whatever you can spare brings us one step closer to a country where no parent ever gets the call I got.](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=db30c315691a4515bea185ac725b2e78&_e=3EX7KXYXUztVueKaJmYKv6jdsMDmGxX5Unjx5ndYCRYU88MgCR8axed10Q8mAiwrbod4-bFMQJEuL7UmvjdP3AWzvFGw2I-RiZxl4RO6DMcPj3CUDfoG0WV11cPRhCrZNLeB9z9g1vAqPfDPcFhZbfSQzEYPacgKuGrNsd3hTBKNenm7Xmh3mZ1GvZ4T3C1i-Gv37pUizAiOTBqcVQf5lpFjhBnz8NpdXCh5jd4U8nxLBS0PF35GADM7nJLfl_E-4Anl5IHfKTYaQr_iPSwY4Tq9GBlo2E_DLVz40rsD3DtRjE-d0D5QsTSS0mXfa01c_YAegUKPJeDRsgkXZfcBvgMZcVhAkWb7TqPgscIkn2CXBQJ2Jg6Ew2t8xdH-0qob5FLJBtspKMmcT-zd3LNq3rSN7nkn9Wg7gkv5LcwJ1s5MS4v2RbsI9oJE7CnGfFxIr0vKE9V1GnbkzuL5eellN7tjea0Pzq8rhFV2Cn9OQR5QutTrySXfHX52aRRs2JZ0KC95rgSUnA_P5jLtHpt3jp_j2HJyjbtPYPJRHxiCLH4%3D)**

[ **CHIP IN $25 TO HELP JOE WIN** ](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=db30c315691a4515bea185ac725b2e78&_e=3EX7KXYXUztVueKaJmYKv6jdsMDmGxX5Unjx5ndYCRYU88MgCR8axed10Q8mAiwrbod4-bFMQJEuL7UmvjdP3AWzvFGw2I-RiZxl4RO6DMcPj3CUDfoG0WV11cPRhCrZNLeB9z9g1vAqPfDPcFhZbfSQzEYPacgKuGrNsd3hTBKNenm7Xmh3mZ1GvZ4T3C1ibRu9kOCm8qrec85QL-4avpj8XsBWh_6BZlt8sJllZ6PdmhZC89OlwjLt8zOwrKap7hTVogKYo1f7HwooOVuATMXfb-XaqnqWLCKxdmu9Mq_Gq-KlVaqk8lstAZfd0BwPJWc8VsQPUOoedjRGG_3scyZjQoIy-9YscmgqfBRF6m2AvLeFNY4G5JWWVZhfzMmvoWm6UWuS_iHtu_Uy6ZT7o82ktAynBN2w4r5WNKNX54BhJxeUh3VxNSGxvZ2F_uCMs7SjMfTnT8vOHfYAym9tAhdHyavQGKoUPVxk11BZtdA2fSW-xuHTdukJv_6gBSw09vl3BwZAVS8X0HzeTZ05otH4syu1cqUXyadL_GKVzYA%3D)
---

I will never get my son back. I have made my peace with that. But I can spend the rest of my life making sure another family does not live my nightmare — and with your help, I will.

**[Thank you for reading this, and thank you for standing with me.](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=db30c315691a4515bea185ac725b2e78&_e=3EX7KXYXUztVueKaJmYKv6jdsMDmGxX5Unjx5ndYCRYU88MgCR8axed10Q8mAiwrbod4-bFMQJEuL7UmvjdP3AWzvFGw2I-RiZxl4RO6DMcPj3CUDfoG0WV11cPRhCrZNLeB9z9g1vAqPfDPcFhZbfSQzEYPacgKuGrNsd3hTBKNenm7Xmh3mZ1GvZ4T3C1iwM945U2XIacBKHtc5p-_HrkPt7J7YnMqYr3uqR3ny70CqegV4ZyrvZ1ltlXPHEUEfLe03ioy8eYI0IaGAXCll6k06nmJKGII77SkNf7ej_jXh_wULpOyLy0s2OPqFS5-No5GczXcLW0YQcU-6j1HHv9TmRWJuR-NUFkfjm4itrQ9H4UG4N2CPkgbcf6BE5Bo2azNGi-LoGtxh3jGYvCjgH8Da1QdMkBTVE3IAp3mK6-O2EZWfYuBUUUK8C0Jt3RNTj9ZfnoozFTiSjPUipOJsu1pHHO3usjA5MM7ZWHB7ZhDwDujIkznkCNQ6wkvGNKL_LO51V9N50Xs9BgMPW7eS7uhRdw6RmIQ_Fp_N0uqwWU%3D)**

Semper Fi,
Joe Males
Sergeant, USMC Veteran

Peter,
Nancy Mace just introduced a hateful, racist constitutional amendment to ban naturalized citizens from serving in Congress.
**She targeted me specifically in her announcement — trying to paint me as disloyal to this country.**
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260520.0KAPXO&refcode=em20260520-6262&t=2&akid=6262%2E420207%2EDsDjc7)
**Let me be clear: My naturalization ceremony was one of the most meaningful days of my life.** I stood with hundreds of people from across the world who waited, in many cases for decades, to become American citizens. I will never forget that moment, and I feel so proud of my American citizenship everyday.
But this isn’t just an attack on me. It’s an insult to the hundreds of thousands of constituents who elected naturalized citizens into office. It’s an insult to the millions of immigrants who helped shape this country into what it is today.
**With the exception of Native Americans, every person in America — including Nancy Mace — is descended from immigrants.** America is strong because of the people from across the world with diverse talents who come here to live and work.
And now, instead of working to help the American people while so many cannot keep the lights on, put food on the table, or pay their rent, Nancy Mace is introducing discriminatory legislation that denies the very history of a country so proudly shaped by immigrants.
This narrow-minded, xenophobic legislation has no place in Congress. I call on all my colleagues — including my Republican colleagues who are naturalized citizens — to condemn this.

Pramila Jayapal

| Hi folks, I’m incredibly honored to have Rep. Rashida Tlaib’s endorsement.

I first met Rashida in 2017 when she was running for Congress. She told me about how she fought back against a Koch brothers-backed corporation that was polluting her district — and won.

It was immediately clear to me that she was going to be someone who would go to Washington and take on any fight, even against her own party, if it was the right thing to do.

And that’s exactly what she’s done.

Time and time again, Rashida has been a voice of moral clarity in Congress. She stood up for Palestinian rights and fought to stop the genocide in Gaza even when the entire political establishment came after her for it.

That kind of courage matters. Because when even one person is willing to speak clearly and refuse to back down, it changes what’s politically possible.

Rashida’s leadership is a huge part of why we’ve seen the political landscape begin to shift on Israel. It’s why even moderate Democrats are now being forced to distance themselves from AIPAC or call for restrictions on military aid.

She showed people that you don’t have to accept the limits the establishment tries to place on what can be said or fought for. That’s the kind of politics I believe in too.

When we launched the Green New Deal, people said it was impossible. But by fighting unapologetically for a bold vision, we changed the conversation across the entire country and helped pave the way for the largest climate investment in American history.

Real change happens when people are willing to lead with conviction instead of fear.

That’s why I’m running for Congress.

We need a Democratic Party willing to stand up to corporate power, fight for working people, and end our support for Israel’s genocide in Gaza.

And we need more voices in Congress willing to say what too many politicians are afraid to say.

If you’re with us, I’d love for you to sign up to donate or help spread the word about our campaign today.

She showed people that you don’t have to accept the limits the establishment tries to place on what can be said or fought for. That’s the kind of politics I believe in too. When we launched the Green New Deal, people said it was impossible. But by fighting unapologetically for a bold vision, we changed the conversation across the entire country and helped pave the way for the largest climate investment in American history. Real change happens when people are willing to lead with conviction instead of fear. That’s why I’m running for Congress. We need a Democratic Party willing to stand up to corporate power, fight for working people, and end our support for Israel’s genocide in Gaza. And we need more voices in Congress willing to say what too many politicians are afraid to say. If you’re with us, I’d love for you to sign up to donate or help spread the word about our campaign today. In solidarity, Saikat Chakrabarti Democrat for Congress, CA-11 | | | | | Saikat Chakrabarti was Bernie’s Tech Director, AOC’s first chief of staff, founded Justice Democrats, and helped bring the Green New Deal to life. He’s running for Congress to build a San Francisco that works for everyone—teachers, immigrants, service workers, and everyone else who makes this city the best in the world. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Hey Peter, this is Summer Lee.

Thanks to this people-powered movement, not only did we out-organize AIPAC
in Pittsburgh to protect my House seat in PA-12 yesterday, but we
successfully beat them to elect another Justice Democrat from
Pennsylvania: Chris Rabb in PA-03.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260520-2.v7laBl&refcode=em20260520-37798&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=37798%2E1203867%2EzB9NOq ]Tweet by Justice Democrats: wake up y'all Pennsylvania is going to have
two Justice Democrats in Congress

Chris has always been the progressive champion we desperately need more of
in Congress, and who Philly deserves. He bucked the status quo and fought
for working-class Philadelphians as a State Representative alongside me in
Harrisburg, and I know he’s going to do the same when he joins me in
Washington next year.

Chris took on the Israel lobby, just like I did, and beat them. He wasn’t
afraid to call for a free Palestine, abolishing ICE, passing Medicare for
All, and making billionaires pay their fair share.

That’s why the establishment sided with his corporate-backed opponent and
attacked him in the final weeks of this race. But once again, we proved
that organized people beat organized money.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260520-2.v7laBl&refcode=em20260520-37798&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=37798%2E1203867%2EzB9NOq ]Photo of Chris Rabb and Summer Lee with members of their campaigns
outside at a park.

Congress has enough of the go-along-to-get-along folks maintaining
business as usual while our working-class communities struggle — the
bluest district in the entire country deserves better. With Chris, we got
it.

Justice Democrats first reached out to me in 2021 to run for Congress.
Then, they gave me the support to build a grassroots campaign capable of
taking on AIPAC and Republican billionaires.

In 2022, we proved we can elect a different kind of Democrat who shows up
for working families in PA. Then, we did it again in 2024. And again in
2026, in both mine and Chris’s races.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260520-2.v7laBl&refcode=em20260520-37798&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=37798%2E1203867%2EzB9NOq ]Photo of Chris Rabb and Summer Lee

From Pittsburgh to Philly, anchored by grassroots movements on the ground
locally, yesterday’s primary results further prove that Pennsylvanians are
ready for bold leadership that meets this moment and prioritizes real
people, not corporate power.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260520-2.v7laBl&refcode=em20260520-37798&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1005&akid=37798%2E1203867%2EzB9NOq ]You helped me and Chris win big, so let’s help other JD candidates win
their upcoming primaries. Make a contribution of any amount right now to
fuel Justice Democrats’ work to send 10 more progressive fighters to
Congress this year.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260520-2.v7laBl&refcode=em20260520-37798&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1024&akid=37798%2E1203867%2EzB9NOq ]Contribute $5

Together, we’re building a politics rooted in justice, dignity, and people
power.

In solidarity,

Summer Lee

The
judicial hearings under the Trump administration are a sham.

Trump’s nominees are handed the softest possible test — questions about
reality: Who won the 2020 election? Was January 6 an attack on the U.S.
Capitol?

And time and again, they refuse to answer.

These nominees choose to avoid historical fact and hide behind rehearsed
non-answers and legal wordplay — dodging any answer that might upset
Trump.

Senator Richard Blumenthal called it what it is:

“I am insulted as a member of this body that you won’t tell us the truth...
You’ve all been carefully rehearsed... I think you failed the test.”

He’s right. They failed — deliberately.

These nominees are demonstrating loyalty. They’re signaling that they’ll
protect Trump’s lies, excuse political violence, and stay silent when
democracy is attacked, all in exchange for a lifetime seat on the bench.

And here’s the most enraging part... Nineteen Senate Democrats are voting to
confirm these judges

Nineteen. Let that sink in.

And every vote “yes” helps pack the courts with Trump cronies — judges who
won’t defend elections, won’t condemn insurrection, and won’t protect our
rights when it counts.

Demand Justice PAC is done pretending this is normal. We’re calling out
the nominees and the Democrats enabling them. Because letting this slide
is how democracy erodes.

I wanted to take a moment to answer a question I think a lot of people
have in races like this.

What does a small contribution, like $15, actually do?

The honest answer is, more than you might think.

In a campaign like ours, $15 helps us reach more voters – whether that’s
through digital ads, organizing, or getting our message in front of people
before outside groups define this race.

It helps us respond when attacks start. It helps us grow this campaign
step by step. And it adds up quickly when a lot of people pitch in at
once.

That’s especially important right now.

Polls show this race is going to be close, and my opponents have the
backing of billionaire donors ready to spend whatever it takes to try to
flip this seat.

I’m building this campaign differently — powered by people, not special

We’ve been reviewing the initial responses from our **Spring Priorities Survey** , and the feedback from across Arizona is already pouring in, team. The Arizona Democratic Party is built on the values and concerns of everyday Arizonans, and we’re currently finalizing our strategy to build a stronger, more equitable state. So far, your fellow grassroots supporters have identified three major priorities:

body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTM3MjQyNjYS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjQ2MDYzODI3NwS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
It’s official: The Senate voted to confirm “Sell-Off Steve” Pearce, giving him
control over 245 million acres of public lands and waters — which he voted to

Just imagine what that money could have gone towards
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2223%2E791427%2EX0J9rC)
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-may26.WVAuyg&refcode=em260520-2-180&t=2&akid=2223%2E791427%2EX0J9rC)
**$29 billion.**
That’s how much taxpayer money we’ve flushed down the drain on Trump's useless, needless, and bloody war with Iran. It’s most likely an underestimate, too.
Just imagine what that money could have gone towards instead of death, destruction, and destabilization.
According to the Department of Housing and Urban Development, it would cost **$20 billion** to end homelessness in the United States.
It would cost **$30 billion** a year to provide universal free school meals to every student in America, a bill I reintroduced just last week.
The USPS could cover its losses from 2025 and get on track toward a sound financial footing with just another **$9 billion** in funding.
**$12 billion** could fund every program that Trump slashed at the Department of Education. **$3 billion** could cover the cost of critical medical research programs that he slashed at the National Institutes of Health. Just **$1.1 billion** could restore the Corporation for Public Broadcasting and fully fund NPR and PBS.
Friend — how our government spends our money is all about priorities, and I am confident that the vast majority of Americans would rather see their money go towards housing, healthcare, education, and quality services rather than endless wars in the Middle East.
[**If you agree, I’m asking you to chip in to my campaign as we fight to reset our spending priorities in America and create a government that actually provides for its people. From Navy helicopter pilot to Congress
| Fellow American,
I know your inbox is probably overflowing right now with politicians begging for your hard-earned money using every scare tactic in the book.
I truly hate having to send messages like this, but I really appreciate your time!
My last message didn't get the response I was hoping for, and now I'm starting to feel like we're falling behind. We can't keep fighting if we don't have the resources to keep the lights on and pay my amazing staff.
Let me take a second to re-introduce myself: My name is Jen Kiggans.
I am a former Navy helicopter pilot. I flew H-46s and H-3s in the Persian Gulf. After my time in the military, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a board-certified Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. I am married to a retired Navy F/A-18 pilot, and now I am a proud Navy Mom.

I knew that I needed to step up and do my part to make sure that my four kids inherit a GREAT America!
Against all odds, we flipped Virginia's 2nd District RED in one of the tightest, must-win races in the entire country. But elections have serious consequences and these radical Left Democrats are not going to give up without a fight.
Now, National Democrats and Left-leaning Super PACs are raking in millions to attack me and take back the House this year. They want to turn our great commonwealth into California AND my far-Left opponent JUST announced she raised over $1.75 MILLION in the first quarter alone.
They will stop at absolutely nothing to win.

| [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs-em-ossoff.coN5Ny&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260520_PM1_V1_S1&t=3&akid=9808%2E5257348%2Ete55-u) _Thank you, Georgia!_ After last night primary, I am officially the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Georgia. This race in Georgia is likely to be the most competitive and expensive U.S. Senate race in 2026. I am the *only* endangered Democratic incumbent U.S. Senator in the midterms. Republicans are preparing to unleash massive resources attacking me and this seat. But our victory will be powered once again by overwhelming grassroots support. If you know the stakes and how important your support is — and if you are ready to split a donation to help start the general election in the strongest position possible and support Adam Schiff — please use this link: **[secure.actblue.com/donate/abs-em-ossoff?refcode=General-Election](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs-em-ossoff.coN5Ny&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260520_PM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=9808%2E5257348%2Ete55-u)** Otherwise, let me tell you a bit about why I ran for Senate — and why this moment is just as urgent. Before I was elected, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. We exposed wrongdoing in countries where criticizing the government is dangerous, where whistleblowers and witnesses will only meet in secret, where protest carries the risk of prosecution. More and more, the atmosphere under Trump has reminded me of those places — places where dissent was silenced by intimidation and where unaccountable elites plunder and trade power for profit with impunity. I ran for Senate because I saw that Trump’s election endangered our Republic and I was determined to confront him and the corruption that made his rise possible. _And that work isn’t over yet._ **This is not a drill and it’s not a bad dream. As citizens, it’s the test of our lifetimes.** So please, I’m humbly asking: **[Split a contribution between my reelection campaign and Adam Schiff. Do it today and help us start the general election in the strongest possible position.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs-em-ossoff.coN5Ny&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260520_PM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=9808%2E5257348%2Ete55-u)** We know MAGA’s election playbook: _Lie. Enrage. Distract._ And between the Fulton County raid, the executive order attacking voting, and the plotting of the MAGA loyalists on our state election board... they've made their plans very clear. But we’ve beaten them before — _right here in Georgia._ In 2021, we defeated an entrenched GOP incumbent by staying on offense and organizing a turnout effort totally unprecedented in its scale and intensity. **This is the next test.** And the best insurance against MAGA’s dirty tricks is _landslide margins of victory._ My team is preparing a larger-than-ever-before effort to get out the vote and defend voting rights. That work is not easy or cheap. We have to work relentlessly through Election Day, and we need the resources to reach every single voter. **[So, I have to ask: Can you please make a donation to my reelection campaign and Adam Schiff?](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs-em-ossoff.coN5Ny&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260520_PM1_V1_S1&t=6&akid=9808%2E5257348%2Ete55-u)** The average donation to this campaign is around $30. Many give less. Some give more. **What matters is that we show strength in numbers — and that we show it now.** | [SPLIT A DONATION](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs-em-ossoff.coN5Ny&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260520_PM1_V1_S1&t=7&akid=9808%2E5257348%2Ete55-u)

| Peter,

I wanted to share an important update on where this race stands as we officially enter the final stretch before Primary Day. **We are almost a month away from the election.**

Early voting is around the corner. And as far as we are concerned, the primary is already underway.

**So, before we get into the state of the race,[_will you please contribute what you can to help us finish strong_?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131791482/622310119/-1721553747?refcode=BLU_EM_AFMC_2026-05-20_1&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MTY3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZDYyMjg4MS1hMDU0LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tCWW-YeKY7mL12Tioe7ibY0riWhxNEvnHfnG5Jx3Xi0=)**

| | **The State of the Race**
---
This campaign has real momentum.

While outside groups and Super PACs are spending heavily to influence this election, we are building something stronger: a broad coalition of people who believe Montgomery County deserves practical, results-driven leadership.

Multiple Super PACs supporting one of my opponents have already begun spending big, and more is likely coming.

_But here is what they do not have:_

The enthusiasm of career and volunteer firefighters, retired MCPS educators, housing affordability advocates, and the Coalition for Equitable Representation in Government, CERG 2.0.

The support of nonprofit leaders, labor leaders, and elected officials from every corner of Montgomery County.

We have the broadest and deepest coalition of support, and that matters. Because it reflects something important: people who know this county best believe in what we are building together.
**What This Race Is About**
This race has become a clear choice about affordability and leadership.

Recently, I voted NO on a County budget that included tax increases on Montgomery County residents and created a structural hole of $293 million to start next year.

I did that because I believe something simple:

You cannot make Montgomery County more affordable by making it more expensive to live here.

While others changed positions throughout this process, I stayed consistent because families across this county are already struggling with rising housing costs, groceries, utilities, childcare, and gas.

Montgomery County needs leadership focused on fiscal responsibility, economic growth, and delivering real results, not bigger deficits and higher costs.
**What We Are Doing Right Now**
We are doing the work every single day:

**🔷** Reaching voters across the county
**🔷** Running phone banks and canvases
**🔷** Expanding our organizing operation
**🔷** Keeping our ads on the air
**🔷** Building the strongest grassroots campaign in this race

But these final weeks will decide everything. Outside money is pouring in, and we need the resources to share our winning message of trusted leadership on affordability.

clean_body: as far as we are concerned, the | = | Peter, I wanted to share an important update on where this race stands as we officially enter the final stretch before Primary Day. We are almost a month away from the election. Early voting is around the corner. And as far as we are concerned, the primary is already underway. So, before we get into the state of the race,= | | The State of the Race This campaign has real momentum. While outside groups and Super PACs are spending heavily to influence this election, we are building something stronger: a broad coalition of people who believe Montgomery County deserves practical, results-driven leadership. Multiple Super PACs supporting one of my opponents have already begun spending big, and more is likely coming. But here is what they do not have: The enthusiasm of career and volunteer firefighters, retired MCPS educators, housing affordability advocates, and the Coalition for Equitable Representation in Government, CERG 2.0. The support of nonprofit leaders, labor leaders, and elected officials from every corner of Montgomery County. We have the broadest and deepest coalition of support, and that matters. Because it reflects something important: people who know this county best believe in what we are building together. What This Race Is About This race has become a clear choice about affordability and leadership. Recently, I voted NO on a County budget that included tax increases on Montgomery County residents and created a structural hole of $293 million to start next year. I did that because I believe something simple: You cannot make Montgomery County more affordable by making it more expensive to live here. While others changed positions throughout this process, I stayed consistent because families across this county are already struggling with rising housing costs, groceries, utilities, childcare, and gas. Montgomery County needs leadership focused on fiscal responsibility, economic growth, and delivering real results, not bigger deficits and higher costs. What We Are Doing Right Now We are doing the work every single day: 🔷 Reaching voters across the county 🔷 Running phone banks and canvases 🔷 Expanding our organizing operation 🔷 Keeping our ads on the air 🔷 Building the strongest grassroots campaign in this race But these final weeks will decide everything. Outside money is pouring in, and we need the resources to share our winning message of trusted leadership on affordability. = | | | = | = | = | = | = Thank you for standing with us in this important moment. = * | | = By Authority: Friends of Andrew Friedson, Rose Hacking, Treasurer Friends of Andrew Friedson PO Box 2562 Rockville, MD 20847 United States | =

These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.

That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens.

And it's not isolated growth anymore.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida
✅ Idaho
✅ Indiana
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Oklahoma
✅ South Carolina
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action.

That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly.

It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up.

Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through.

And right now, that's where we're stretched.

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

We're working to keep up with both.

_So here 's how you can help... _

Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it.

**An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: **

✅ Constitutions.
✅ Chapter guides.
✅ Flags.
✅ Materials to organize and lead.

It turns a student who wants to speak up... _into one who actually does. _

I came home tonight, distraught, and decided I had to write down the truth for the one person I trust most: **you.** Our Majority, and more importantly, President Trump’s future, is hanging by a thread. A _**_single Senate race_**_ will decide if the liberals block every single thing he tries to do. If we lose, he is finished. The stakes are overwhelming. I won't be able to look him in the eye knowing I didn't do absolutely everything to keep every seat. Peter, I am appealing to you now, _not as a Senator,_ but as a conservative who has nowhere left to turn. The only way I can possibly move forward is if you read my confidential note, understand the danger, and take action. Please, please, click the link below now. The time for deliberation is over. I didn’t run for Senate to sit quietly on the sidelines. I’m a mom, a conservative, and a proud Alabamian—and I came to fight for the values that make America strong.

_**Faith. Family. Freedom.**_

The Left is doing _everything_ they can to tear it all down. But I didn’t come to Washington to play games. I came to fight for the people who feel forgotten, overlooked, and ignored.

From securing the border to protecting our kids and defending our way of life—I’m in this for the long haul.

**This fight isn’t easy, but it’s worth it. And I’m not going anywhere.**

Will you stand with me?

name: Team AOC
subject: Alexandria’s plan
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Alexandria has a plan to help Democrats take back the House of Representatives from Republican control this November.
We have to show people that we’ll fight for them; Democrats can’t just say what we’re against. We have to share what we’re _for._
The stakes of what we’re contending with at this moment are high: the Voting Rights Act, redistricting in Louisiana, the climate crisis, and more.
Alexandria is working relentlessly to help Democrats take back the House by electing progressive leaders who will fight for the people they represent, not corporate interests.
**Alexandria is supporting progressive candidates across the country, including two candidates in Pennsylvania and Georgia this week.**
She’s going to keep fighting to support candidates who will stand up for working people.
[ So today, we’re asking if you will split a $4 donation between Courage to Change — Alexandria’s PAC that supports progressive candidates — and our campaign for progress.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260520-ctc.hBWWPT&refcode=em20260520-11471-P_FND_SPL_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=11471%2E2526796%2EyIryTJ)
Your support will make sure we can keep up the fight to support leaders who will join Alexandria on the front lines of the fights that matter most.
**[Contribute $4](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260520-ctc.hBWWPT&refcode=em20260520-11471-P_FND_SPL_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=11471%2E2526796%2EyIryTJ)**
This is a hard moment to be someone who still believes that another world is possible. But it’s moments like this that it’s most important of all.
A better world is possible. We have to keep fighting for it. Because there will be a day after this presidency and it belongs to all of us.
More soon,
Team AOC

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20260520-ctc?refcode=em20260520-11471-P_FND_SPL_HDL&t=21&refcode2=11471_2526796_yIryTJ&akid=11471%2E2526796%2EyIryTJ)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20260520-11471-P_FND_SPL_HDL&t=22&akid=11471%2E2526796%2EyIryTJ)**

In March, Kevin Kiley held a press conference and announced he was leaving the Republican Party. He called himself an Independent. He wants you to believe he's a changed man — a brave moderate willing to break from the MAGA crowd.

When Trump needed votes for the Big Beautiful Bill — 887 pages of Medicaid cuts, gutted SNAP benefits, shredded clean energy programs, and $3.3 trillion added to the national debt — Kevin Kiley was there.
He delivered for Trump when it counted most, and then had the audacity to put out a press release calling it "historic tax relief for Californians."

I'm a Marine Corps veteran, a Harvard Kennedy School graduate, and someone who has spent his entire career in service to this country. When I get to Congress, I won't be looking for a convenient label to hide behind. I'll be fighting to restore what Kiley helped tear down: robust Medicaid protections, strong public land preservation, and a government that actually works for the people who live here — not the MAGA donors who fund campaigns like his.
